# Functions
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(broom.mixed)


# =========================
# Longitudinal Heatmaps (CONTROL & CELIAC)
# =========================
# df: your *combined* table (e.g., contig_total_PA.with_celiac)
# tp_levels: order of timepoints *without* baseline "t0"
# term_prefix: prefix used by the main TP terms in the model (CONTROL side)
# fdr: BH threshold
# value: "log_odds" or "OR" for the fill
# min_hits: keep contigs with >= this many significant cells (per group)
# return_data: also return the plotting data.tables
make_longitudinal_heatmaps_both <- function(
  df,
  tp_levels = c("t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42"),
  term_prefix = "onset_timeline_combined",
  fdr = 0.05,
  value = c("log_odds","OR"),
  min_hits = 1,
  return_data = TRUE
) {
  stopifnot(all(c("contig_id","term","estimate","p.value","p.adj") %in% names(df)))
  value <- match.arg(value)

  # ------------ Helpers ------------
  build_heat_df_control <- function(df) {
  tp_terms <- paste0(term_prefix, tp_levels)
  out <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(term %in% tp_terms, !grepl(":", term)) %>%   # main TP effects (CONTROL)
    dplyr::mutate(
      TP       = gsub(paste0("^", term_prefix), "", term),
      TP       = factor(TP, levels = tp_levels),
      log_odds = estimate,
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      sig      = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < fdr
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(sig) %>%                     # <-- keep only significant cells
    dplyr::mutate(
      value_sig = if (value == "log_odds") log_odds else OR,
      group     = "CONTROL",
      TP        = forcats::fct_drop(TP)        # drop unused TP levels so only sig columns show
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(contig_id) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= min_hits) %>%  # contig must have >= min_hits sig cells
    dplyr::ungroup()
  out
}

build_heat_df_celiac <- function(df) {
  out <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^TP \\(CELIAC\\):", term)) %>%
    tidyr::extract(term, into = "TP", regex = "TP \\(CELIAC\\):\\s*([^ ]+)\\s+vs\\s+t0", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TP       = factor(TP, levels = tp_levels),
      log_odds = estimate,
      OR       = exp(estimate),
      sig      = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < fdr
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(sig) %>%                     # <-- keep only significant cells
    dplyr::mutate(
      value_sig = if (value == "log_odds") log_odds else OR,
      group     = "CELIAC",
      TP        = forcats::fct_drop(TP)        # drop unused TP levels so only sig columns show
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(contig_id) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= min_hits) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  out
}

 order_rows <- function(dd) {
  if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(dd)
  ord_levels <- dd %>%
    dplyr::group_by(contig_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      max_abs = max(abs(value_sig), na.rm = TRUE),
      hits    = sum(!is.na(value_sig)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(max_abs), dplyr::desc(hits)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(contig_id)

  dplyr::mutate(dd, contig_id = factor(contig_id, levels = ord_levels))
}

  plot_one <- function(dd, title_group) {
    if (nrow(dd) == 0L) {
      message("No contigs pass filters for ", title_group, ". Returning empty plot.")
      return(ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::theme_void())
    }
    fill_scale <- if (value == "log_odds") {
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
        name = "Log-odds\n(FDR < threshold)",
        low = "#2b8cbe", mid = "white", high = "#d7301f", midpoint = 0, na.value = "grey92"
      )
    } else {
      ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
        name = "Odds ratio\n(FDR < threshold)",
        low = "#2b8cbe", mid = "white", high = "#d7301f", midpoint = 1,
        trans = "log10", na.value = "grey92"
      )
    }
    ggplot2::ggplot(dd, ggplot2::aes(x = TP, y = contig_id, fill = value_sig)) +
      ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
      fill_scale +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = paste0("Longitudinal (TP vs t0) — ", title_group),
        subtitle = paste0("Cells colored when BH FDR < ", fdr,
                          "; fill = ", if (value == "log_odds") "log-odds" else "OR"),
        x = "Timepoint (vs t0)", y = "Contig"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "right"
      )
  }

  # ------------ Build data ------------
  heat_control <- build_heat_df_control(df) %>% order_rows()
  heat_celiac  <- build_heat_df_celiac(df)  %>% order_rows()

  # ------------ Make plots ------------
  p_control <- plot_one(heat_control, "CONTROL")
  p_celiac  <- plot_one(heat_celiac,  "CELIAC")

  if (return_data) {
    invisible(list(
      p_control = p_control,
      p_celiac  = p_celiac,
      data_control = heat_control,
      data_celiac  = heat_celiac
    ))
  } else {
    invisible(list(p_control = p_control, p_celiac = p_celiac))
  }
}



# ==========================
# Auto Heatmaps (Complete, tailored to your labels)
# ==========================
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Catalog of timepoint-based families matching YOUR labels ----
.family_catalog <- tibble::tribble(
  ~family,                    ~match_regex,                                            ~tp_regex,                                                                 ~note,
  "TP (CONTROL)",             "^onset_timeline_combined",                              "onset_timeline_combined(t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)$",                     "main TP effects in CONTROL",
  "TP (CELIAC)",              "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):",                                     "TP \\(CELIAC\\):\\s*\\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\)\\s+vs\\s+t0",        "CELIAC vs t0 (with parentheses)",
  "Between groups",           "^CONTROL vs CELIAC @\\s*",                              "^CONTROL vs CELIAC @\\s*(t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)$",                     "between-group at each timepoint",
  "Dx × TP interactions",     "^Dx\\.Status\\w+:onset_timeline_combined",              "onset_timeline_combined(t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)$",                     "interaction rows carrying a TP token"
  # If you later add adjacent labels, you can re-enable/add patterns here.
)

# ---- Detect which families exist in df$term ----
detect_timepoint_families <- function(df) {
  stopifnot("term" %in% names(df))
  .family_catalog %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(has = any(grepl(match_regex, df$term))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(has) %>%
    pull(family)
}



# ---- Build a single family's heatmap (significant cells only) ----
make_family_heatmap <- function(
    df, family, tp_levels,
    fdr = 0.05,
    scale = c("log", "natural"),
    min_contigs = 1,
    analysis_type = c("PA", "abundance")
  ) {
    scale <- match.arg(scale)
    analysis_type <- match.arg(analysis_type)
    stopifnot(all(c("contig_id","term","estimate","p.adj") %in% names(df)))

    spec <- .family_catalog %>% filter(family == !!family)
    if (nrow(spec) == 0) stop("Unknown family: ", family)

    # 1) Filter rows for this family
    sel <- df %>% filter(str_detect(term, spec$match_regex[1]))
    if (!nrow(sel)) {
      return(
        ggplot() + theme_void() +
          annotate("text", x = .5, y = .5,
                   label = paste0("term family '", family, "' doesn't have any rows"),
                   size = 5) + xlim(0,1) + ylim(0,1)
      )
    }

    # 2) Extract timepoint token using family-specific regex
    tp_mat <- stringr::str_match(sel$term, spec$tp_regex[1])
    # For families with one captured TP group, it's in column 2
    if (ncol(tp_mat) >= 2) {
      sel$TP <- tp_mat[,2]
    } else {
      # Fallback for CONTROL: sometimes simpler to strip prefix if regex failed
      if (family == "TP (CONTROL)") {
        sel$TP <- sub("^onset_timeline_combined", "", sel$term)
      } else {
        sel$TP <- NA_character_
      }
    }

    # 3) Keep significant cells only - FIXED LINE BELOW
    sel <- sel %>%
      mutate(
        TP        = factor(TP, levels = tp_levels),
        sig       = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < fdr,
        value_sig = if (scale == "natural") exp(estimate) else estimate  # FIXED: regular if/else
      ) %>%
      filter(sig, !is.na(TP))

    if (!nrow(sel)) {
      return(
        ggplot() + theme_void() +
          annotate("text", x = .5, y = .5,
                   label = paste0("term family '", family, "' doesn't have any significant contigs"),
                   size = 5) + xlim(0,1) + ylim(0,1)
      )
    }

    # 4) Keep contigs with ≥ min_contigs significant cells in this family
    keep_ids <- sel %>% count(contig_id, name = "hits") %>% filter(hits >= min_contigs) %>% pull(contig_id)
    sel <- sel %>% filter(contig_id %in% keep_ids)
    if (!nrow(sel)) {
      return(
        ggplot() + theme_void() +
          annotate("text", x = .5, y = .5,
                   label = paste0("term family '", family, "': no contigs pass min_contigs = ", min_contigs),
                   size = 5) + xlim(0,1) + ylim(0,1)
      )
    }

    # 5) Order contigs by max |effect|
    ord <- sel %>%
      group_by(contig_id) %>%
      summarise(max_abs = max(abs(value_sig), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(max_abs)) %>%
      pull(contig_id)

    sel$contig_id <- factor(sel$contig_id, levels = ord)
    sel$TP        <- droplevels(sel$TP)

    # 6) Plot - ANALYSIS-SPECIFIC LABELS
    if (analysis_type == "PA") {
      # For presence/absence (logistic regression)
      fill_scale <- if (scale == "log") {
        scale_fill_gradient2(
          name = "log-odds",
          low = "#2b8cbe",
          mid = "white",
          high = "#d7301f",
          midpoint = 0,
          limits = c(-700, 500), # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
          oob = scales::squish # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
        )
      } else {
        scale_fill_gradient2(
          name = "OR",
          low = "#2b8cbe",
          mid = "white",
          high = "#d7301f",
          midpoint = 1,
          trans = "log10",
          limits = c(exp(-700), exp(500)), # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
          oob = scales::squish # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
        )
      }
    } else {
      # For abundance (negative binomial regression)
      fill_scale <- if (scale == "log") {
        scale_fill_gradient2(
          name = "log fold-change",
          low = "#2b8cbe",
          mid = "white",
          high = "#d7301f",
          midpoint = 0,
          limits = c(-700, 500), # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
          oob = scales::squish # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
        )
      } else {
        scale_fill_gradient2(
          name = "Fold-change",
          low = "#2b8cbe",
          mid = "white",
          high = "#d7301f",
          midpoint = 1,
          trans = "log10",
          limits = c(exp(-700), exp(500)), # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
          oob = scales::squish # comment this out when making heatmaps for multiple significant cells
        )
      }
    }

    # Determine subtitle text based on analysis type
    scale_text <- if (analysis_type == "PA") {
      if (scale == "log") "log-odds" else "OR"
    } else {
      if (scale == "log") "log fold-change" else "fold-change"
    }

    ggplot(sel, aes(x = TP, y = contig_id, fill = value_sig)) +
      geom_tile(
        width = 0.95,
        height = 0.95,
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ) +
      fill_scale +
      scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
      scale_y_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0("Heatmap — ", family),
        subtitle = paste0("Only significant cells (BH FDR < ", fdr, ")"),
        x = "Timepoint",
        y = "contig"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "right"
      )
  }


auto_heatmaps_detected <- function(
    df, tp_levels,
    fdr = 0.05,
    scale = c("log", "natural"),
    min_contigs = 1,
    analysis_type = c("PA", "abundance")
  ) {
    scale <- match.arg(scale)
    analysis_type <- match.arg(analysis_type)
    fams  <- detect_timepoint_families(df)
    if (length(fams) == 0) {
      message("No timepoint-based families detected in `term`.")
      return(list())
    }
    out <- setNames(vector("list", length(fams)), fams)
    for (fam in fams) {
      out[[fam]] <- make_family_heatmap(
        df = df,
        family = fam,
        tp_levels = tp_levels,
        fdr = fdr,
        scale = scale,
        min_contigs = min_contigs,
        analysis_type = analysis_type
      )
    }
    out
  }




# Extract timepoint-specific interaction rows and add per-gene FDR
extract_timepoint_results <- function(model_results,
                                      model_name,
                                      gene_col = "contig_id",
                                      adjust_method = "BH") {
  if (is.null(model_results) || nrow(model_results) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  timepoint_results <- model_results %>%
    # keep interaction terms of interest
    filter(grepl("Dx.StatusCELIAC:onset_timeline_combined", term)) %>%
    mutate(
      timepoint = gsub("Dx.StatusCELIAC:onset_timeline_combined", "", term),
      model     = model_name,
      # safer than get(): pull from the data frame by name
      gene      = .data[[gene_col]]
    ) %>%
    select(gene, timepoint, estimate, std.error, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, model) %>%
    # per gene x model, adjust p across that gene's timepoints
    group_by(gene, model) %>%
    mutate(
      p.adj = {
        pv <- p.value
        ok <- !is.na(pv)
        out <- rep(NA_real_, length(pv))
        if (any(ok)) out[ok] <- p.adjust(pv[ok], method = adjust_method)
        out
      },
      n_tests_gene = n()  # handy to audit how many timepoints were tested for this gene
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  timepoint_results
}




# Apply to all result objects you keep in the workspace for a cohort
extract_all_timepoints <- function(cohort_name, adjust_method = "BH") {
  results_list <- list()

  # PA models
  try({
    obj <- paste0(cohort_name, "_glmmTMB_logit_results")
    if (exists(obj)) {
      results_list[["PA_model1"]] <- extract_timepoint_results(
        get(obj), "PA_glmmTMB_logit", gene_col = "contig_id", adjust_method = adjust_method
      )
    }
  }, silent = TRUE)

  # Abundance models
  try({
    obj <- paste0(cohort_name, "_nb_results")
    if (exists(obj)) {
      results_list[["abundance_model1"]] <- extract_timepoint_results(
        get(obj), "abundance_nbinom", gene_col = "contig_id", adjust_method = adjust_method
      )
    }
  }, silent = TRUE)

  if (length(results_list) > 0) {
    do.call(rbind, results_list)
  } else {
    data.frame()
  }
}
```

# create total PA table
```{r generate total PA table}

total.target_cpm      <- 0.5   # e.g., 0.25–1.0 for very sparse data
total.min_reads_floor <- 3L    # guard against singletons

## ---- 1) Align samples ------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(all(colnames(total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03) %in% rownames(total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)))
# Reorder metadata to match counts columns
total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03 <- total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03[colnames(total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03), , drop = FALSE]

## ---- 2) Build DGEList & normalize (TMMwsp) --------------------------------

total.y <- DGEList(counts = total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, samples = total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
# Optional: drop genes with all zeros (purely empty rows)
total.y <- total.y[rowSums(total.y$counts) > 0, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

# Library-size normalization (robust for sparse data)
total.y <- calcNormFactors(total.y, method = "TMMwsp")

## ---- 3) CPM-anchored presence/absence -------------------------------------
# Normalized CPMs (uses effective library sizes = lib.size * norm.factors)
total.cpm_mat <- edgeR::cpm(total.y, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)

# Presence rule: CPM >= target_cpm AND raw count >= min_reads_floor
total.present_logical <- (total.cpm_mat >= total.target_cpm) & (total.y$counts >= total.min_reads_floor)

# Convert to 0/1 matrix with dimnames preserved
total.PA <- matrix(
  as.integer(total.present_logical),
  nrow = nrow(total.present_logical),
  ncol = ncol(total.present_logical),
  dimnames = dimnames(total.present_logical)
)

dim(total.PA)
# 109 243
```

```{r PA_glmmTMB_logit_total}
library(glmmTMB)
library(broom.mixed)

# Create long-format data for total cohort
contig_total_pa_long <- total.PA %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("contig_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -contig_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "PA") %>%
  left_join(total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id")


# Fit model for each contig
contig_total_PA_glmmTMB_logit_results <- contig_total_pa_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ {
      tryCatch({
        glmmTMB(PA ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID),
                family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = .x)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }),
    tidy_results = map(model, ~ {
      if (!is.null(.x)) {
        tryCatch(tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      } else NULL
    })
  ) %>%
  select(contig_id, tidy_results) %>%
  unnest(tidy_results)


contig_total_PA.adjusted.results <- contig_total_PA_glmmTMB_logit_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%   # often you adjust per term of interest
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## total - calculate the non-reference level (in my case, CELIAC) stats
```{r}

# ---- add right after your contig_total_PA.adjusted.results code ----
library(emmeans)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(glmmTMB)

# 0) Define timepoint order (must include "t0" first)
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")
stopifnot("t0" %in% tp_levels)

# 1) Refit per-contig models (just for emmeans; your original table is untouched)
contig_total_PA_models_for_emm <- contig_total_pa_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(
        PA ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex +
             Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
             HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
             (1 | patientID),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
        data   = .x
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  select(contig_id, model)

# 2) Helper: get CELIAC TP vs t0 contrasts from emmeans (with SE/CI/p)
# --- Safe helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (handles z.ratio/t.ratio/none) ---
# SAFE helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (uses base::summary, robust CIs/statistic)
extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0 <- function(mod, tp_levels, dx_level = "CELIAC") {
  if (is.null(mod) || !("t0" %in% tp_levels)) return(tibble())

  # emmeans across timepoints within Dx
  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(
      mod, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
      at = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
      type = "link"  # log-odds scale
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  # contrasts: each TP vs t0 (within each Dx)
  ref_idx <- which(tp_levels == "t0")[1]
  con <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = ref_idx),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(con)) return(tibble())

  # IMPORTANT: use base::summary(), not emmeans::summary()
  s <- tibble::as_tibble(summary(con, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))

  # unify 'statistic' column (z.ratio OR t.ratio OR NA)
  if (!("statistic" %in% names(s))) {
    zr <- if ("z.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$z.ratio else NULL
    tr <- if ("t.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$t.ratio else NULL
    s$statistic <- dplyr::coalesce(zr, tr, rep(NA_real_, nrow(s)))
  }

  # ensure CI columns
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- tryCatch(tibble::as_tibble(confint(con)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(ci)) {
      byk <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
      s <- dplyr::left_join(
        s,
        dplyr::select(ci, dplyr::any_of(c(byk, "lower.CL","upper.CL","asymp.LCL","asymp.UCL"))),
        by = byk
      )
      if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.LCL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- s$asymp.LCL
      if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.UCL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- s$asymp.UCL
    }
  }
  if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- NA_real_
  if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- NA_real_

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TP        = stringr::str_remove(contrast, " - t0$"),
      term      = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", TP, " vs t0"),
      OR        = exp(estimate)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term,
      estimate,
      std.error = SE,
      statistic,
      p.value,
      conf.low  = lower.CL,
      conf.high = upper.CL,
      OR
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^TP \\(.+\\):\\s*t0\\s+vs\\s+t0$", term))
}


# --- Build the CELIAC rows and append to your original table -------------------
contig_total_PA_celiac_tp_rows <- contig_total_PA_models_for_emm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(out = purrr::map(model, ~ extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0(.x, tp_levels))) %>%
  dplyr::select(contig_id, out) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(out) %>%
  # same per-term FDR rule you used for the original table
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

contig_total_PA.with_celiac <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  contig_total_PA.adjusted.results,  # your original model-term stats
  contig_total_PA_celiac_tp_rows                     # added: CELIAC TP vs t0 stats from emmeans
)


# write.csv(contig_total_PA.with_celiac, "~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/total_contig_PA_model1_glmmTMB_logit_adjusted.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


## total - calculate the per timepoint contrast
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Fit models (you already have this part)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
total_contig_PA_models <- contig_total_pa_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(
        PA ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
          HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = .x
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Extract between-group contrasts (CELIAC - CONTROL → flip)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
extract_contrasts <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())

  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  contr <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(contr)) return(tibble())

  s  <- as_tibble(summary(contr))
  ci <- as_tibble(confint(contr)) %>%
        select(any_of(c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined","lower.CL","upper.CL")))

  keys <- intersect(names(s), names(ci))
  if (length(keys) > 0) {
    s <- left_join(s, ci, by = keys)
  }
  s
}

total_contig_PA_contrast_results <- total_contig_PA_models %>%
  mutate(contrasts = map(model, extract_contrasts)) %>%
  select(contig_id, contrasts) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(contrasts)

# adjust within each timepoint
total_contig_PA_contrast_results <- total_contig_PA_contrast_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(onset_timeline_combined) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Flip CELIAC - CONTROL to CONTROL vs CELIAC
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
between_df <- total_contig_PA_contrast_results %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL$"))

has_z  <- "z.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_t  <- "t.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_SE <- "SE"       %in% names(between_df)
has_l  <- "lower.CL" %in% names(between_df)
has_u  <- "upper.CL" %in% names(between_df)

between_tp_std <- between_df %>%
  mutate(
    est_flip   = -estimate,
    se_use     = if (has_SE) SE else NA_real_,
    stat_use   = if (has_z) z.ratio else if (has_t) t.ratio else NA_real_,
    low_flip   = if (has_l) -upper.CL else NA_real_,
    high_flip  = if (has_u) -lower.CL else NA_real_,
    OR         = exp(est_flip),
    term       = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
    source     = "between_groups"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    contig_id,
    term,
    estimate  = est_flip,
    std.error = se_use,
    statistic = stat_use,
    p.value,
    p.adj,
    conf.low  = low_flip,
    conf.high = high_flip,
    OR,
    source
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Harmonize with your main table (already created earlier)
#    Replace with the object that contains tidy terms + CELIAC contrasts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
common_spec <- list(
  contig_id = NA_character_,
  term      = NA_character_,
  estimate  = NA_real_,
  std.error = NA_real_,
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p.value   = NA_real_,
  p.adj     = NA_real_,
  conf.low  = NA_real_,
  conf.high = NA_real_,
  OR        = NA_real_,
  source    = NA_character_
)

add_missing_cols_typed <- function(df, spec) {
  for (nm in names(spec)) if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- spec[[nm]]
  df
}


# Use your actual main results object here
main_tbl <- contig_total_PA.with_celiac   # <-- adjust if named differently

main_std <- main_tbl %>%
  add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    source = as.character(source),
    source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "model_or_emmeans", source)
  ) %>%
  select(names(common_spec))

if (nrow(between_tp_std) == 0) {
  between_std <- tibble(
    contig_id = character(), term = character(),
    estimate = numeric(), std.error = numeric(), statistic = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(), p.adj = numeric(),
    conf.low = numeric(), conf.high = numeric(),
    OR = numeric(), source = character()
  )
} else {
  between_std <- between_tp_std %>%
    add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      source = as.character(source),
      source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "between_groups", source)
    ) %>%
    select(names(common_spec))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final combined table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
contig_total_PA.everything <- bind_rows(main_std, between_std) %>%
  arrange(contig_id, term)


contig_total_PA.everything %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05)
#   contig_id                term        estimate std.error statistic p.value  p.adj conf.low conf.high    OR source

# 2 virus_comp_15228_cycle_1 (Intercept)    -5.40      2.13     -2.53 0.0115  0.0345    -9.58     -1.21    NA model_or_emmeans
```

## US - calculate the non-reference level (in my case, CELIAC) stats
```{r}

# ---- add right after your contig_total_PA.adjusted.results code ----


# 0) Define timepoint order (must include "t0" first)
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")
stopifnot("t0" %in% tp_levels)

# 1) Refit per-contig models (just for emmeans; your original table is untouched)
contig_US_PA_models_for_emm <- contig_US_pa_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(
        PA ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex +
             Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
             HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
             (1 | patientID),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"),
        data   = .x
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  select(contig_id, model)

# 2) Helper: get CELIAC TP vs t0 contrasts from emmeans (with SE/CI/p)
# --- Safe helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (handles z.ratio/t.ratio/none) ---
# SAFE helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (uses base::summary, robust CIs/statistic)
extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0 <- function(mod, tp_levels, dx_level = "CELIAC") {
  if (is.null(mod) || !("t0" %in% tp_levels)) return(tibble())

  # emmeans across timepoints within Dx
  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(
      mod, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
      at = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
      type = "link"  # log-odds scale
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  # contrasts: each TP vs t0 (within each Dx)
  ref_idx <- which(tp_levels == "t0")[1]
  con <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = ref_idx),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(con)) return(tibble())

  # IMPORTANT: use base::summary(), not emmeans::summary()
  s <- tibble::as_tibble(summary(con, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))

  # unify 'statistic' column (z.ratio OR t.ratio OR NA)
  if (!("statistic" %in% names(s))) {
    zr <- if ("z.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$z.ratio else NULL
    tr <- if ("t.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$t.ratio else NULL
    s$statistic <- dplyr::coalesce(zr, tr, rep(NA_real_, nrow(s)))
  }

  # ensure CI columns
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- tryCatch(tibble::as_tibble(confint(con)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(ci)) {
      byk <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
      s <- dplyr::left_join(
        s,
        dplyr::select(ci, dplyr::any_of(c(byk, "lower.CL","upper.CL","asymp.LCL","asymp.UCL"))),
        by = byk
      )
      if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.LCL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- s$asymp.LCL
      if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.UCL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- s$asymp.UCL
    }
  }
  if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- NA_real_
  if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- NA_real_

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TP        = stringr::str_remove(contrast, " - t0$"),
      term      = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", TP, " vs t0"),
      OR        = exp(estimate)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term,
      estimate,
      std.error = SE,
      statistic,
      p.value,
      conf.low  = lower.CL,
      conf.high = upper.CL,
      OR
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^TP \\(.+\\):\\s*t0\\s+vs\\s+t0$", term))
}


# --- Build the CELIAC rows and append to your original table -------------------
contig_US_PA_celiac_tp_rows <- contig_US_PA_models_for_emm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(out = purrr::map(model, ~ extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0(.x, tp_levels))) %>%
  dplyr::select(contig_id, out) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(out) %>%
  # same per-term FDR rule you used for the original table
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

contig_US_PA.with_celiac <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  contig_US_PA.adjusted.results,  # your original model-term stats
  contig_US_PA_celiac_tp_rows                     # added: CELIAC TP vs t0 stats from emmeans
)


dim(contig_US_PA.with_celiac %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
# 0
```

## US - calculate the per timepoint contrast
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Fit models (you already have this part)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
US_contig_PA_models <- contig_US_pa_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(
        PA ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
          HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = .x
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Extract between-group contrasts (CELIAC - CONTROL → flip)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
extract_contrasts <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())

  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  contr <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(contr)) return(tibble())

  s  <- as_tibble(summary(contr))
  ci <- as_tibble(confint(contr)) %>%
        select(any_of(c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined","lower.CL","upper.CL")))

  keys <- intersect(names(s), names(ci))
  if (length(keys) > 0) {
    s <- left_join(s, ci, by = keys)
  }
  s
}

US_contig_PA_contrast_results <- US_contig_PA_models %>%
  mutate(contrasts = map(model, extract_contrasts)) %>%
  select(contig_id, contrasts) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(contrasts)

# adjust within each timepoint
US_contig_PA_contrast_results <- US_contig_PA_contrast_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(onset_timeline_combined) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Flip CELIAC - CONTROL to CONTROL vs CELIAC
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
between_df <- US_contig_PA_contrast_results %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL$"))

has_z  <- "z.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_t  <- "t.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_SE <- "SE"       %in% names(between_df)
has_l  <- "lower.CL" %in% names(between_df)
has_u  <- "upper.CL" %in% names(between_df)

between_tp_std <- between_df %>%
  mutate(
    est_flip   = -estimate,
    se_use     = if (has_SE) SE else NA_real_,
    stat_use   = if (has_z) z.ratio else if (has_t) t.ratio else NA_real_,
    low_flip   = if (has_l) -upper.CL else NA_real_,
    high_flip  = if (has_u) -lower.CL else NA_real_,
    OR         = exp(est_flip),
    term       = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
    source     = "between_groups"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    contig_id,
    term,
    estimate  = est_flip,
    std.error = se_use,
    statistic = stat_use,
    p.value,
    p.adj,
    conf.low  = low_flip,
    conf.high = high_flip,
    OR,
    source
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Harmonize with your main table (already created earlier)
#    Replace with the object that contains tidy terms + CELIAC contrasts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
common_spec <- list(
  contig_id = NA_character_,
  term      = NA_character_,
  estimate  = NA_real_,
  std.error = NA_real_,
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p.value   = NA_real_,
  p.adj     = NA_real_,
  conf.low  = NA_real_,
  conf.high = NA_real_,
  OR        = NA_real_,
  source    = NA_character_
)

add_missing_cols_typed <- function(df, spec) {
  for (nm in names(spec)) if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- spec[[nm]]
  df
}


# Use your actual main results object here
main_tbl <- contig_US_PA.with_celiac   # <-- adjust if named differently

main_std <- main_tbl %>%
  add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    source = as.character(source),
    source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "model_or_emmeans", source)
  ) %>%
  select(names(common_spec))

if (nrow(between_tp_std) == 0) {
  between_std <- tibble(
    contig_id = character(), term = character(),
    estimate = numeric(), std.error = numeric(), statistic = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(), p.adj = numeric(),
    conf.low = numeric(), conf.high = numeric(),
    OR = numeric(), source = character()
  )
} else {
  between_std <- between_tp_std %>%
    add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      source = as.character(source),
      source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "between_groups", source)
    ) %>%
    select(names(common_spec))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final combined table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
contig_US_PA.everything <- bind_rows(main_std, between_std) %>%
  arrange(contig_id, term)


contig_US_PA.everything %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05)
# 0

write.csv(contig_US_PA.everything,"~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/US_contig_PA_results_everything.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL$"))

has_z  <- "z.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_t  <- "t.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_SE <- "SE"       %in% names(between_df)
has_l  <- "lower.CL" %in% names(between_df)
has_u  <- "upper.CL" %in% names(between_df)

between_tp_std <- between_df %>%
  mutate(
    est_flip   = -estimate,
    se_use     = if (has_SE) SE else NA_real_,
    stat_use   = if (has_z) z.ratio else if (has_t) t.ratio else NA_real_,
    low_flip   = if (has_l) -upper.CL else NA_real_,
    high_flip  = if (has_u) -lower.CL else NA_real_,
    OR         = exp(est_flip),
    term       = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
    source     = "between_groups"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    contig_id,
    term,
    estimate  = est_flip,
    std.error = se_use,
    statistic = stat_use,
    p.value,
    p.adj,
    conf.low  = low_flip,
    conf.high = high_flip,
    OR,
    source
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Harmonize with your main table (already created earlier)
#    Replace with the object that contains tidy terms + CELIAC contrasts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
common_spec <- list(
  contig_id = NA_character_,
  term      = NA_character_,
  estimate  = NA_real_,
  std.error = NA_real_,
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p.value   = NA_real_,
  p.adj     = NA_real_,
  conf.low  = NA_real_,
  conf.high = NA_real_,
  OR        = NA_real_,
  source    = NA_character_
)

add_missing_cols_typed <- function(df, spec) {
  for (nm in names(spec)) if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- spec[[nm]]
  df
}


# Use your actual main results object here
main_tbl <- contig_Italy_PA.with_celiac   # <-- adjust if named differently

main_std <- main_tbl %>%
  add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    source = as.character(source),
    source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "model_or_emmeans", source)
  ) %>%
  select(names(common_spec))

if (nrow(between_tp_std) == 0) {
  between_std <- tibble(
    contig_id = character(), term = character(),
    estimate = numeric(), std.error = numeric(), statistic = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(), p.adj = numeric(),
    conf.low = numeric(), conf.high = numeric(),
    OR = numeric(), source = character()
  )
} else {
  between_std <- between_tp_std %>%
    add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      source = as.character(source),
      source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "between_groups", source)
    ) %>%
    select(names(common_spec))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final combined table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
contig_Italy_PA.everything <- bind_rows(main_std, between_std) %>%
  arrange(contig_id, term)
```

## Total cohort - Negative Binomial GLMM (2 significant)
```{r abundance_NB_total}
library(edgeR)
library(glmmTMB)

# Prepare DGEList and normalization for total cohort
total.y <- DGEList(counts = total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, samples = total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
total.y <- calcNormFactors(total.y, method = "TMMwsp")
total.lib_eff <- with(total.y$samples, lib.size * norm.factors)

# Create long-format data for abundance modeling
contig_total_abundance_long <- total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("contig_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -contig_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count") %>%
  left_join(total.y$samples %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(offset = log(lib.size * norm.factors))

# Fit NB model for each contig
contig_total_abundance_nb_results <- contig_total_abundance_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ {
      tryCatch({
        glmmTMB(count ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID) + offset(offset),
                family = nbinom2, data = .x)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }),
    tidy_results = map(model, ~ {
      if (!is.null(.x)) {
        tryCatch(tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      } else NULL
    })
  ) %>%
  select(contig_id, tidy_results) %>%
  unnest(tidy_results)


contig_total_abundance.adjusted.results <- contig_total_abundance_nb_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%   # often you adjust per term of interest
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(contig_total_abundance.adjusted.results %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
# 14
```

## total - calculate the non-reference level (in my case, CELIAC) stats
```{r}

# ---- add right after your contig_total_PA.adjusted.results code ----
library(emmeans)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(glmmTMB)

# 0) Define timepoint order (must include "t0" first)
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")
stopifnot("t0" %in% tp_levels)

# 1) Refit per-contig models (just for emmeans; your original table is untouched)
contig_total_abundance_models_for_emm <- contig_total_abundance_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(count ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID) + offset(offset),
                family = nbinom2, data = .x),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  select(contig_id, model)

# 2) Helper: get CELIAC TP vs t0 contrasts from emmeans (with SE/CI/p)
# --- Safe helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (handles z.ratio/t.ratio/none) ---
# SAFE helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (uses base::summary, robust CIs/statistic)
extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0 <- function(mod, tp_levels, dx_level = "CELIAC") {
  if (is.null(mod) || !("t0" %in% tp_levels)) return(tibble())

  # emmeans across timepoints within Dx
  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(
      mod, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
      at = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
      type = "link"  # log-odds scale
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  # contrasts: each TP vs t0 (within each Dx)
  ref_idx <- which(tp_levels == "t0")[1]
  con <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = ref_idx),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(con)) return(tibble())

  # IMPORTANT: use base::summary(), not emmeans::summary()
  s <- tibble::as_tibble(summary(con, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))

  # unify 'statistic' column (z.ratio OR t.ratio OR NA)
  if (!("statistic" %in% names(s))) {
    zr <- if ("z.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$z.ratio else NULL
    tr <- if ("t.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$t.ratio else NULL
    s$statistic <- dplyr::coalesce(zr, tr, rep(NA_real_, nrow(s)))
  }

  # ensure CI columns
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- tryCatch(tibble::as_tibble(confint(con)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(ci)) {
      byk <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
      s <- dplyr::left_join(
        s,
        dplyr::select(ci, dplyr::any_of(c(byk, "lower.CL","upper.CL","asymp.LCL","asymp.UCL"))),
        by = byk
      )
      if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.LCL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- s$asymp.LCL
      if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.UCL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- s$asymp.UCL
    }
  }
  if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- NA_real_
  if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- NA_real_

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TP        = stringr::str_remove(contrast, " - t0$"),
      term      = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", TP, " vs t0"),
      OR        = exp(estimate)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term,
      estimate,
      std.error = SE,
      statistic,
      p.value,
      conf.low  = lower.CL,
      conf.high = upper.CL,
      OR
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^TP \\(.+\\):\\s*t0\\s+vs\\s+t0$", term))
}


# --- Build the CELIAC rows and append to your original table -------------------
contig_total_abundance_celiac_tp_rows <- contig_total_abundance_models_for_emm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(out = purrr::map(model, ~ extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0(.x, tp_levels))) %>%
  dplyr::select(contig_id, out) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(out) %>%
  # same per-term FDR rule you used for the original table
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

contig_total_abundance.with_celiac <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  contig_total_abundance.adjusted.results,  # your original model-term stats
  contig_total_abundance_celiac_tp_rows                     # added: CELIAC TP vs t0 stats from emmeans
)

dim(contig_total_abundance.with_celiac %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
# 14

```


## total - calculate the per timepoint contrast
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Fit models (you already have this part)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
total_contig_abundance_models <- contig_total_abundance_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(count ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID) + offset(offset),
                family = nbinom2, data = .x),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Extract between-group contrasts (CELIAC - CONTROL → flip)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
extract_contrasts <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())

  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  contr <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(contr)) return(tibble())

  s  <- as_tibble(summary(contr))
  ci <- as_tibble(confint(contr)) %>%
        select(any_of(c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined","lower.CL","upper.CL")))

  keys <- intersect(names(s), names(ci))
  if (length(keys) > 0) {
    s <- left_join(s, ci, by = keys)
  }
  s
}

total_contig_abundance_contrast_results <- total_contig_abundance_models %>%
  mutate(contrasts = map(model, extract_contrasts)) %>%
  select(contig_id, contrasts) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(contrasts)

# adjust within each timepoint
total_contig_abundance_contrast_results <- total_contig_abundance_contrast_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(onset_timeline_combined) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Flip CELIAC - CONTROL to CONTROL vs CELIAC
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
between_df <- total_contig_abundance_contrast_results %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL$"))

has_z  <- "z.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_t  <- "t.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_SE <- "SE"       %in% names(between_df)
has_l  <- "lower.CL" %in% names(between_df)
has_u  <- "upper.CL" %in% names(between_df)

between_tp_std <- between_df %>%
  mutate(
    est_flip   = -estimate,
    se_use     = if (has_SE) SE else NA_real_,
    stat_use   = if (has_z) z.ratio else if (has_t) t.ratio else NA_real_,
    low_flip   = if (has_l) -upper.CL else NA_real_,
    high_flip  = if (has_u) -lower.CL else NA_real_,
    OR         = exp(est_flip),
    term       = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
    source     = "between_groups"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    contig_id,
    term,
    estimate  = est_flip,
    std.error = se_use,
    statistic = stat_use,
    p.value,
    p.adj,
    conf.low  = low_flip,
    conf.high = high_flip,
    OR,
    source
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Harmonize with your main table (already created earlier)
#    Replace with the object that contains tidy terms + CELIAC contrasts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
common_spec <- list(
  contig_id = NA_character_,
  term      = NA_character_,
  estimate  = NA_real_,
  std.error = NA_real_,
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p.value   = NA_real_,
  p.adj     = NA_real_,
  conf.low  = NA_real_,
  conf.high = NA_real_,
  OR        = NA_real_,
  source    = NA_character_
)

add_missing_cols_typed <- function(df, spec) {
  for (nm in names(spec)) if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- spec[[nm]]
  df
}


# Use your actual main results object here
main_tbl <- contig_total_abundance.with_celiac   # <-- adjust if named differently

main_std <- main_tbl %>%
  add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    source = as.character(source),
    source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "model_or_emmeans", source)
  ) %>%
  select(names(common_spec))

if (nrow(between_tp_std) == 0) {
  between_std <- tibble(
    contig_id = character(), term = character(),
    estimate = numeric(), std.error = numeric(), statistic = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(), p.adj = numeric(),
    conf.low = numeric(), conf.high = numeric(),
    OR = numeric(), source = character()
  )
} else {
  between_std <- between_tp_std %>%
    add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      source = as.character(source),
      source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "between_groups", source)
    ) %>%
    select(names(common_spec))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final combined table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
contig_total_abundance.everything <- bind_rows(main_std, between_std) %>%
  arrange(contig_id, term)


dim(contig_total_abundance.everything %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
```

```{r}
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(count ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined +  Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID) + offset(offset),
                family = nbinom2, data = .x),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  ) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(model, is.null)) %>%
  select(contig_id, model)

# 2) Helper: get CELIAC TP vs t0 contrasts from emmeans (with SE/CI/p)
# --- Safe helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (handles z.ratio/t.ratio/none) ---
# SAFE helper: CELIAC TP vs t0 with emmeans (uses base::summary, robust CIs/statistic)
extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0 <- function(mod, tp_levels, dx_level = "CELIAC") {
  if (is.null(mod) || !("t0" %in% tp_levels)) return(tibble())

  # emmeans across timepoints within Dx
  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(
      mod, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
      at = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
      type = "link"  # log-odds scale
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  # contrasts: each TP vs t0 (within each Dx)
  ref_idx <- which(tp_levels == "t0")[1]
  con <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = ref_idx),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(con)) return(tibble())

  # IMPORTANT: use base::summary(), not emmeans::summary()
  s <- tibble::as_tibble(summary(con, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))

  # unify 'statistic' column (z.ratio OR t.ratio OR NA)
  if (!("statistic" %in% names(s))) {
    zr <- if ("z.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$z.ratio else NULL
    tr <- if ("t.ratio" %in% names(s)) s$t.ratio else NULL
    s$statistic <- dplyr::coalesce(zr, tr, rep(NA_real_, nrow(s)))
  }

  # ensure CI columns
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- tryCatch(tibble::as_tibble(confint(con)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(ci)) {
      byk <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
      s <- dplyr::left_join(
        s,
        dplyr::select(ci, dplyr::any_of(c(byk, "lower.CL","upper.CL","asymp.LCL","asymp.UCL"))),
        by = byk
      )
      if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.LCL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- s$asymp.LCL
      if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s) && "asymp.UCL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- s$asymp.UCL
    }
  }
  if (!"lower.CL" %in% names(s)) s$lower.CL <- NA_real_
  if (!"upper.CL" %in% names(s)) s$upper.CL <- NA_real_

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TP        = stringr::str_remove(contrast, " - t0$"),
      term      = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", TP, " vs t0"),
      OR        = exp(estimate)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      term,
      estimate,
      std.error = SE,
      statistic,
      p.value,
      conf.low  = lower.CL,
      conf.high = upper.CL,
      OR
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^TP \\(.+\\):\\s*t0\\s+vs\\s+t0$", term))
}


# --- Build the CELIAC rows and append to your original table -------------------
contig_US_abundance_celiac_tp_rows <- contig_US_abundance_models_for_emm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(out = purrr::map(model, ~ extract_celiac_tp_vs_t0(.x, tp_levels))) %>%
  dplyr::select(contig_id, out) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(out) %>%
  # same per-term FDR rule you used for the original table
  dplyr::group_by(term) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

contig_US_abundance.with_celiac <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  contig_US_abundance.adjusted.results,  # your original model-term stats
  contig_US_abundance_celiac_tp_rows                     # added: CELIAC TP vs t0 stats from emmeans
)

dim(contig_US_abundance.with_celiac %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
# 16
```

## US - calculate the per timepoint contrast
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Fit models (you already have this part)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
US_contig_abundance_models <- contig_US_abundance_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ tryCatch(
      glmmTMB(count ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID) + offset(offset),
                family = nbinom2, data = .x),
      error = function(e) NULL
    ))
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Extract between-group contrasts (CELIAC - CONTROL → flip)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
extract_contrasts <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())

  emm <- tryCatch(
    emmeans(fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(emm)) return(tibble())

  contr <- tryCatch(
    contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(contr)) return(tibble())

  s  <- as_tibble(summary(contr))
  ci <- as_tibble(confint(contr)) %>%
        select(any_of(c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined","lower.CL","upper.CL")))

  keys <- intersect(names(s), names(ci))
  if (length(keys) > 0) {
    s <- left_join(s, ci, by = keys)
  }
  s
}

US_contig_abundance_contrast_results <- US_contig_abundance_models %>%
  mutate(contrasts = map(model, extract_contrasts)) %>%
  select(contig_id, contrasts) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(contrasts)

# adjust within each timepoint
US_contig_abundance_contrast_results <- US_contig_abundance_contrast_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(onset_timeline_combined) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Flip CELIAC - CONTROL to CONTROL vs CELIAC
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
between_df <- US_contig_abundance_contrast_results %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL$"))

has_z  <- "z.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_t  <- "t.ratio"  %in% names(between_df)
has_SE <- "SE"       %in% names(between_df)
has_l  <- "lower.CL" %in% names(between_df)
has_u  <- "upper.CL" %in% names(between_df)

between_tp_std <- between_df %>%
  mutate(
    est_flip   = -estimate,
    se_use     = if (has_SE) SE else NA_real_,
    stat_use   = if (has_z) z.ratio else if (has_t) t.ratio else NA_real_,
    low_flip   = if (has_l) -upper.CL else NA_real_,
    high_flip  = if (has_u) -lower.CL else NA_real_,
    OR         = exp(est_flip),
    term       = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
    source     = "between_groups"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    contig_id,
    term,
    estimate  = est_flip,
    std.error = se_use,
    statistic = stat_use,
    p.value,
    p.adj,
    conf.low  = low_flip,
    conf.high = high_flip,
    OR,
    source
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Harmonize with your main table (already created earlier)
#    Replace with the object that contains tidy terms + CELIAC contrasts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
common_spec <- list(
  contig_id = NA_character_,
  term      = NA_character_,
  estimate  = NA_real_,
  std.error = NA_real_,
  statistic = NA_real_,
  p.value   = NA_real_,
  p.adj     = NA_real_,
  conf.low  = NA_real_,
  conf.high = NA_real_,
  OR        = NA_real_,
  source    = NA_character_
)

add_missing_cols_typed <- function(df, spec) {
  for (nm in names(spec)) if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- spec[[nm]]
  df
}


# Use your actual main results object here
main_tbl <- contig_US_abundance.with_celiac   # <-- adjust if named differently

main_std <- main_tbl %>%
  add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    source = as.character(source),
    source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "model_or_emmeans", source)
  ) %>%
  select(names(common_spec))

if (nrow(between_tp_std) == 0) {
  between_std <- tibble(
    contig_id = character(), term = character(),
    estimate = numeric(), std.error = numeric(), statistic = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(), p.adj = numeric(),
    conf.low = numeric(), conf.high = numeric(),
    OR = numeric(), source = character()
  )
} else {
  between_std <- between_tp_std %>%
    add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      source = as.character(source),
      source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "between_groups", source)
    ) %>%
    select(names(common_spec))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final combined table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
contig_US_abundance.everything <- bind_rows(main_std, between_std) %>%
  arrange(contig_id, term)


dim(contig_US_abundance.everything %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
# 16

write.csv(contig_US_abundance.everything,"~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/US_contig_abundance_results_everything.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r abundance_NB_Italy}
# Prepare DGEList and normalization for Italy cohort
Italy.y <- DGEList(counts = Italy.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03, samples = Italy.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03)
Italy.y <- calcNormFactors(Italy.y, method = "TMMwsp")
Italy.lib_eff <- with(Italy.y$samples, lib.size * norm.factors)

# Create long-format data for abundance modeling
contig_Italy_abundance_long <- Italy.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("contig_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -contig_id, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "count") %>%
  left_join(Italy.y$samples %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(offset = log(lib.size * norm.factors))

# Fit NB model for each contig
contig_Italy_abundance_nb_results <- contig_Italy_abundance_long %>%
  group_by(contig_id) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ {
      tryCatch({
        glmmTMB(count ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. + 
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID) + offset(offset),
                family = nbinom2, data = .x)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }),
    tidy_results = map(model, ~ {
      if (!is.null(.x)) {
        tryCatch(tidy(.x, conf.int = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      } else NULL
    })
  ) %>%
  select(contig_id, tidy_results) %>%
  unnest(tidy_results)

contig_Italy_abundance.adjusted.results <- contig_Italy_abundance_nb_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(p.value)) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%   # often you adjust per term of interest
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(contig_Italy_abundance.adjusted.results %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
```

```{r}
}


# Use your actual main results object here
main_tbl <- contig_Italy_abundance.with_celiac   # <-- adjust if named differently

main_std <- main_tbl %>%
  add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
  mutate(
    source = as.character(source),
    source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "model_or_emmeans", source)
  ) %>%
  select(names(common_spec))

if (nrow(between_tp_std) == 0) {
  between_std <- tibble(
    contig_id = character(), term = character(),
    estimate = numeric(), std.error = numeric(), statistic = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(), p.adj = numeric(),
    conf.low = numeric(), conf.high = numeric(),
    OR = numeric(), source = character()
  )
} else {
  between_std <- between_tp_std %>%
    add_missing_cols_typed(common_spec) %>%
    mutate(
      source = as.character(source),
      source = ifelse(is.na(source) | source == "", "between_groups", source)
    ) %>%
    select(names(common_spec))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Final combined table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
contig_Italy_abundance.everything <- bind_rows(main_std, between_std) %>%
  arrange(contig_id, term)


dim(contig_Italy_abundance.everything %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05))
# 16

write.csv(contig_Italy_abundance.everything,"~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/Italy_contig_abundance_results_everything.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Compositional analysis selfmade - Alpha

# total - fit the model
```{r}

# ── Packages ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(glmmTMB)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)

# ── 0) Inputs: counts + metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# counts: rows=contigs (features), cols=samples (counts)
count_mat <- total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta_df   <- total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame()

stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(count_mat)), !is.null(colnames(count_mat)))
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(meta_df)))

# align by common samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_mat), rownames(meta_df))
count_mat <- count_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
meta_df   <- meta_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ── 1) Build phyloseq (no tree needed) ────────────────────────────────────────
OTU <- otu_table(count_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
SAM <- sample_data(meta_df)
ps  <- phyloseq(OTU, SAM)

# exposure / library size (replace with effective lib size if you have it)
lib_size <- sample_sums(ps)
sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize <- as.numeric(lib_size)
sample_data(ps)$offset_log  <- log(pmax(sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize, 1))

# ── 2) Alpha diversity per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_samp_taxa <- t(otu_table(ps))                    # samples x taxa
observed <- vegan::specnumber(otu_samp_taxa)
shannon  <- vegan::diversity(otu_samp_taxa, index = "shannon")

alpha_tbl <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(observed),
  Observed  = as.numeric(observed),
  Shannon   = as.numeric(shannon)
)


alpha_all <- alpha_tbl %>%
  left_join(meta_df %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eff_libsize = as.numeric(lib_size[sample_id]),
    offset_log  = log(pmax(eff_libsize, 1)),
    # factors to match your other models
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"), # we set celiac as the reference level here
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Country = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Country), "ITALY"),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Dx.Status, onset_timeline_combined, patientID)


# ── 3) GLOBAL models (same structure as PA/abundance) ─────────────────────────
# Observed richness ~ NB with offset + random intercept
fit_obs <- glmmTMB(
  Observed ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined +
    Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID) + offset(offset_log),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = alpha_all
)

levels(alpha_all$Dx.Status)

# Shannon ~ Gaussian LMM with random intercept
fit_shan <- glmmTMB(
  Shannon ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined +
    Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID),
  family = gaussian(),   # <- key change
  data = alpha_all
)



```


# total - extract outputs and make plots
```{r}

## ===== RUN THIS RIGHT AFTER fit_shan and fit_obs ARE CREATED =====

# packages
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# Timepoint order
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")

# ---------- Pretty labels for fixed terms (CONTROL is the reference) ----------
pretty_label <- function(x, ref_dx = "CONTROL") {
  x %>%
    # MAIN TIMEPOINTS (CONTROL as ref): capture suffix and append "vs t0"
    stringr::str_replace("^onset_timeline_combined(.*)$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0") %>%
    # INTERACTIONS (drop the "CELIAC" word)
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.Status.*:onset_timeline_combined", "Dx × TP: ") %>%
    # MAIN Dx
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC$", paste0("Dx: CELIAC (vs ", ref_dx, ")")) %>%
    # OTHER COVARIATES (your set)
    stringr::str_replace("^SexMale$", "Sex: Male (vs Female)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryHigh Risk$", "HLA: High Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryLow/No Risk$", "HLA: Low/No Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearFormula$", "Feeding: Formula (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearBreastmilk_and_formula$", "Feeding: Mixed (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Delivery\\.ModeC-Section$", "Delivery: C-Section (vs Vaginal)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Age\\.at\\.Gluten\\.Introduction\\.\\.months\\.$", "Age at gluten intro (months)")
}

# ---------- Standardize emmeans output ----------
emm_summary_df <- function(emm_contrast) {
  s <- as_tibble(summary(emm_contrast, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- as_tibble(confint(emm_contrast))
    by_keys <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
    s <- left_join(s, select(ci, any_of(c(by_keys, "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))), by = by_keys)
  }
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s)) && all(c("estimate","SE") %in% names(s))) {
    s <- mutate(s, lower.CL = estimate - 1.96*SE, upper.CL = estimate + 1.96*SE)
  }
  s
}

# ---------- Helpers to build contrast tables ----------
# A) TP vs t0 within a Dx level (we'll use for CONTROL)
tp_vs_t0_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = which(tp_levels == "t0"))
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    mutate(
      lhs = str_trim(str_remove(contrast, " - t0$")),
      rhs = "t0",
      term_label = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
      section = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels)
    )
}

# B) Adjacent timepoint contrasts within a Dx level (enforce exact adjacency)
tp_adjacent_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )

  out <- contrast(emm, method = "consec")              # consecutive diffs in tp_levels order
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)                           # ensures we have lower.CL/upper.CL

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # emmeans names are like "t0-12 - t0-6" → convert to "t0-12 vs t0-6"
      term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx_level, "): ",
                          stringr::str_replace(contrast, "\\s-\\s", " vs ")),
      section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      # extract lhs/rhs for ordering keys
      lhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "^[^\\-]+") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      rhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "(?<=-)\\s*.*$") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
      # simple within-group running index (1 = t0-6 vs t0, 2 = t0-12 vs t0-6, …)
      adj_index = dplyr::row_number()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(conf.low = lower.CL, conf.high = upper.CL)
}


# C) Between-group (CONTROL vs CELIAC) at each timepoint
dx_by_tp_tbl <- function(fit, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(str_detect(contrast, "CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL")) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      lhs_key    = factor(onset_timeline_combined, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
}

# D) Fixed terms (tidy)
fixed_terms_tbl <- function(fit, model_label) {
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = pretty_label(term, ref_dx = "CELIAC"),
      section    = "Fixed terms",
      model      = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, section, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
}

# ---------- Master builder for ONE fit ----------
build_all_sections <- function(fit, model_label,
                               tp_levels,
                               dx_levels_vst0 = "CONTROL",                 # CONTROL vs t0
                               dx_levels_adj  = c("CELIAC","CONTROL"),     # adjacent for both
                               type_link = TRUE, p_adjust = "BH") {

  # --- fixed terms (already have conf.low/conf.high) ---
  fixed_tbl <- fixed_terms_tbl(fit, model_label) %>%
    mutate(source = "fixed")

  # --- emmeans tables ---
  vs_t0_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_vst0, ~ tp_vs_t0_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  adj_tbl   <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_adj,  ~ tp_adjacent_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  dx_tp_tbl <- dx_by_tp_tbl(fit, tp_levels, type_link)

  # Standardize column names for all emmeans outputs
  std_emm <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      # emmeans gives lower.CL / upper.CL; rename to the plotting names
      dplyr::rename(conf.low  = dplyr::any_of("lower.CL"),
                    conf.high = dplyr::any_of("upper.CL")) %>%
      # keep required columns (others are kept if present)
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "section","term_label","estimate","conf.low","conf.high","p.value",
        "lhs_key","rhs_key","adj_index"
      )), dplyr::everything())
  }

  emm_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    std_emm(vs_t0_tbl),
    std_emm(adj_tbl),
    std_emm(dx_tp_tbl)
  ) %>%
    mutate(source = "emmeans")

  # --- combine & compute FDR inside each model×section ---
  res <- dplyr::bind_rows(fixed_tbl, emm_tbl) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(model, section) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = p_adjust),
                  sig   = p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # ensure helpers exist for ordering (used later)
  if (!"adj_index" %in% names(res)) res$adj_index <- NA_integer_
  if (!"lhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$lhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)
  if (!"rhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$rhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)

  res
}


# ---------- Build data for BOTH models ----------
dat_all <- bind_rows(
  build_all_sections(fit_shan, model_label = "Shannon",               tp_levels = tp_levels),
  build_all_sections(fit_obs,  model_label = "Observed (link scale)", tp_levels = tp_levels)
)

# Ensure ordering helpers exist
if (!"adj_index" %in% names(dat_all)) dat_all$adj_index <- NA_integer_

# Final label normalizations (safety)
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Between groups:\\s*", ""),                    # just in case
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\): \\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\) vs t0$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0"),
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "\\s+vs\\s+t0(?:\\s+vs\\s+t0)+$", " vs t0"),   # dedupe "vs t0"
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL ×", "Dx ×")
  )


# Helper to extract a TP token from any label
extract_tp <- function(x) str_extract(x, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0")

# ---------- Re-block and order ----------
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    tp_token = extract_tp(term_label),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels),

    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                              ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):") ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")  ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")   ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx × TP: ")         ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)") ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                          ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                              ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    ))
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model, block,
    if_else(is.na(adj_index), Inf, as.double(adj_index)),  # strict order for Adjacent panels
    as.numeric(tp_key),                                    # order by timepoint elsewhere
    term_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_label = dplyr::if_else(
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      stringr::str_replace_all(term_label, "\\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\)", "\\1"),
      term_label
    )
  )  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model, block) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



# ---------- Plot ----------
total_contig_alpha_p <- ggplot(dat_all, aes(y = forcats::fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +   # one reference line for all panels
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Timepoint effects, between-group contrasts, interactions, and covariates",
    subtitle = "Observed shown on log(IRR) (ref=0). Shannon shown as raw differences (ref=0).",
    x = "Effect size (log(IRR) for Observed; difference for Shannon)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
  strip.background.y = element_blank(),  # remove the right-side strip background
  strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")  # keep top labels bold
)

total_contig_alpha_p

ggsave(total_contig_alpha_p,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/total_contig_alpha_p.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 10, height = 10)
```
