# US - fit the model
```{r}

# ── 0) Inputs: counts + metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# counts: rows=contigs (features), cols=samples (counts)
count_mat <- US.contig.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta_df   <- US.contig.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame()

stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(count_mat)), !is.null(colnames(count_mat)))
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(meta_df)))

# align by common samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_mat), rownames(meta_df))
count_mat <- count_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
meta_df   <- meta_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ── 1) Build phyloseq (no tree needed) ────────────────────────────────────────
OTU <- otu_table(count_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
SAM <- sample_data(meta_df)
ps  <- phyloseq(OTU, SAM)

# exposure / library size (replace with effective lib size if you have it)
lib_size <- sample_sums(ps)
sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize <- as.numeric(lib_size)
sample_data(ps)$offset_log  <- log(pmax(sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize, 1))

# ── 2) Alpha diversity per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_samp_taxa <- t(otu_table(ps))                    # samples x taxa
observed <- vegan::specnumber(otu_samp_taxa)
shannon  <- vegan::diversity(otu_samp_taxa, index = "shannon")

alpha_tbl <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(observed),
  Observed  = as.numeric(observed),
  Shannon   = as.numeric(shannon)
)


alpha_all <- alpha_tbl %>%
  left_join(meta_df %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eff_libsize = as.numeric(lib_size[sample_id]),
    offset_log  = log(pmax(eff_libsize, 1)),
    # factors to match your other models
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Dx.Status, onset_timeline_combined, patientID)


# ── 3) GLOBAL models (same structure as PA/abundance) ─────────────────────────
# Observed richness ~ NB with offset + random intercept
fit_obs <- glmmTMB(
  Observed ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID) + offset(offset_log),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = alpha_all
)

# Shannon ~ Gaussian LMM with random intercept
fit_shan <- glmmTMB(
  Shannon ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID),
  family = gaussian(),   # <- key change
  data = alpha_all
)


```

```{r}
# packages
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)

# Timepoint order
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")

# ---------- Pretty labels for fixed terms (CONTROL is the reference) ----------
pretty_label <- function(x, ref_dx = "CONTROL") {
  x %>%
    # MAIN TIMEPOINTS (CONTROL as ref): capture suffix and append "vs t0"
    stringr::str_replace("^onset_timeline_combined(.*)$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0") %>%
    # INTERACTIONS (drop the "CELIAC" word)
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.Status.*:onset_timeline_combined", "Dx × TP: ") %>%
    # MAIN Dx
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC$", paste0("Dx: CELIAC (vs ", ref_dx, ")")) %>%
    # OTHER COVARIATES (your set)
    stringr::str_replace("^SexMale$", "Sex: Male (vs Female)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryHigh Risk$", "HLA: High Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryLow/No Risk$", "HLA: Low/No Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearFormula$", "Feeding: Formula (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearBreastmilk_and_formula$", "Feeding: Mixed (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Delivery\\.ModeC-Section$", "Delivery: C-Section (vs Vaginal)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Age\\.at\\.Gluten\\.Introduction\\.\\.months\\.$", "Age at gluten intro (months)")
}

# ---------- Standardize emmeans output ----------
emm_summary_df <- function(emm_contrast) {
  s <- as_tibble(summary(emm_contrast, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- as_tibble(confint(emm_contrast))
    by_keys <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
    s <- left_join(s, select(ci, any_of(c(by_keys, "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))), by = by_keys)
  }
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s)) && all(c("estimate","SE") %in% names(s))) {
    s <- mutate(s, lower.CL = estimate - 1.96*SE, upper.CL = estimate + 1.96*SE)
  }
  s
}

# ---------- Helpers to build contrast tables ----------
# A) TP vs t0 within a Dx level (we'll use for CONTROL)
tp_vs_t0_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = which(tp_levels == "t0"))
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    mutate(
      lhs = str_trim(str_remove(contrast, " - t0$")),
      rhs = "t0",
      term_label = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
      section = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels)
    )
}

# B) Adjacent timepoint contrasts within a Dx level (enforce exact adjacency)
tp_adjacent_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )

  out <- contrast(emm, method = "consec")              # consecutive diffs in tp_levels order
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)                           # ensures we have lower.CL/upper.CL

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # emmeans names are like "t0-12 - t0-6" → convert to "t0-12 vs t0-6"
      term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx_level, "): ",
                          stringr::str_replace(contrast, "\\s-\\s", " vs ")),
      section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      # extract lhs/rhs for ordering keys
      lhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "^[^\\-]+") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      rhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "(?<=-)\\s*.*$") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
      # simple within-group running index (1 = t0-6 vs t0, 2 = t0-12 vs t0-6, …)
      adj_index = dplyr::row_number()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(conf.low = lower.CL, conf.high = upper.CL)
}


# C) Between-group (CONTROL vs CELIAC) at each timepoint
dx_by_tp_tbl <- function(fit, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(str_detect(contrast, "CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL")) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      lhs_key    = factor(onset_timeline_combined, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
}

# D) Fixed terms (tidy)
fixed_terms_tbl <- function(fit, model_label) {
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = pretty_label(term, ref_dx = "CELIAC"),
      section    = "Fixed terms",
      model      = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, section, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
}

# ---------- Master builder for ONE fit ----------
build_all_sections <- function(fit, model_label,
                               tp_levels,
                               dx_levels_vst0 = "CONTROL",                 # CONTROL vs t0
                               dx_levels_adj  = c("CELIAC","CONTROL"),     # adjacent for both
                               type_link = TRUE, p_adjust = "BH") {

  # --- fixed terms (already have conf.low/conf.high) ---
  fixed_tbl <- fixed_terms_tbl(fit, model_label) %>%
    mutate(source = "fixed")

  # --- emmeans tables ---
  vs_t0_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_vst0, ~ tp_vs_t0_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  adj_tbl   <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_adj,  ~ tp_adjacent_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  dx_tp_tbl <- dx_by_tp_tbl(fit, tp_levels, type_link)

  # Standardize column names for all emmeans outputs
  std_emm <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      # emmeans gives lower.CL / upper.CL; rename to the plotting names
      dplyr::rename(conf.low  = dplyr::any_of("lower.CL"),
                    conf.high = dplyr::any_of("upper.CL")) %>%
      # keep required columns (others are kept if present)
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "section","term_label","estimate","conf.low","conf.high","p.value",
        "lhs_key","rhs_key","adj_index"
      )), dplyr::everything())
  }

  emm_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    std_emm(vs_t0_tbl),
    std_emm(adj_tbl),
    std_emm(dx_tp_tbl)
  ) %>%
    mutate(source = "emmeans")

  # --- combine & compute FDR inside each model×section ---
  res <- dplyr::bind_rows(fixed_tbl, emm_tbl) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(model, section) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = p_adjust),
                  sig   = p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # ensure helpers exist for ordering (used later)
  if (!"adj_index" %in% names(res)) res$adj_index <- NA_integer_
  if (!"lhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$lhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)
  if (!"rhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$rhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)

  res
}


# ---------- Build data for BOTH models ----------
dat_all <- bind_rows(
  build_all_sections(fit_shan, model_label = "Shannon",               tp_levels = tp_levels),
  build_all_sections(fit_obs,  model_label = "Observed (link scale)", tp_levels = tp_levels)
)

# Ensure ordering helpers exist
if (!"adj_index" %in% names(dat_all)) dat_all$adj_index <- NA_integer_

# Final label normalizations (safety)
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Between groups:\\s*", ""),                    # just in case
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\): \\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\) vs t0$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0"),
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "\\s+vs\\s+t0(?:\\s+vs\\s+t0)+$", " vs t0"),   # dedupe "vs t0"
    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL ×", "Dx ×")
  )


# Helper to extract a TP token from any label
extract_tp <- function(x) str_extract(x, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0")

# ---------- Re-block and order ----------
dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    tp_token = extract_tp(term_label),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels),

    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                              ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):") ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")  ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")   ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx × TP: ")         ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms"            & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)") ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                          ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                              ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    ))
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    model, block,
    if_else(is.na(adj_index), Inf, as.double(adj_index)),  # strict order for Adjacent panels
    as.numeric(tp_key),                                    # order by timepoint elsewhere
    term_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term_label = dplyr::if_else(
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      stringr::str_replace_all(term_label, "\\((t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?)\\)", "\\1"),
      term_label
    )
  )  %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model, block) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



# ---------- Plot ----------
US_contig_alpha_p <- ggplot(dat_all, aes(y = forcats::fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +   # one reference line for all panels
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Timepoint effects, between-group contrasts, interactions, and covariates",
    subtitle = "Observed shown on log(IRR) (ref=0). Shannon shown as raw differences (ref=0).",
    x = "Effect size (log(IRR) for Observed; difference for Shannon)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
  strip.background.y = element_blank(),  # remove the right-side strip background
  strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")  # keep top labels bold
)
```

# Italy - fit the model
```{r}

# ── 0) Inputs: counts + metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# counts: rows=contigs (features), cols=samples (counts)
count_mat <- Italy.contig.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta_df   <- Italy.contig.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame()

stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(count_mat)), !is.null(colnames(count_mat)))
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(meta_df)))

# align by common samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_mat), rownames(meta_df))
count_mat <- count_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
meta_df   <- meta_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ── 1) Build phyloseq (no tree needed) ────────────────────────────────────────
OTU <- otu_table(count_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
SAM <- sample_data(meta_df)
ps  <- phyloseq(OTU, SAM)

# exposure / library size (replace with effective lib size if you have it)
lib_size <- sample_sums(ps)
sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize <- as.numeric(lib_size)
sample_data(ps)$offset_log  <- log(pmax(sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize, 1))

# ── 2) Alpha diversity per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_samp_taxa <- t(otu_table(ps))                    # samples x taxa
observed <- vegan::specnumber(otu_samp_taxa)
shannon  <- vegan::diversity(otu_samp_taxa, index = "shannon")

alpha_tbl <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(observed),
  Observed  = as.numeric(observed),
  Shannon   = as.numeric(shannon)
)


alpha_all <- alpha_tbl %>%
  left_join(meta_df %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eff_libsize = as.numeric(lib_size[sample_id]),
    offset_log  = log(pmax(eff_libsize, 1)),
    # factors to match your other models
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Dx.Status, onset_timeline_combined, patientID)


# ── 3) GLOBAL models (same structure as PA/abundance) ─────────────────────────
# Observed richness ~ NB with offset + random intercept
fit_obs <- glmmTMB(
  Observed ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID) + offset(offset_log),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = alpha_all
)

# Shannon ~ Gaussian LMM with random intercept
fit_shan <- glmmTMB(
  Shannon ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID),
  family = gaussian(),   # <- key change
  data = alpha_all
)
```

```{r}
## ===== RUN THIS RIGHT AFTER fit_shan and fit_obs ARE CREATED =====

# packages
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# Timepoint order
tp_levels <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")

# ---------- Pretty labels for fixed terms (CONTROL is the reference) ----------
pretty_label <- function(x, ref_dx = "CONTROL") {
  x %>%
    # MAIN TIMEPOINTS (CONTROL as ref): capture suffix and append "vs t0"
    stringr::str_replace("^onset_timeline_combined(.*)$", "TP (CONTROL): \\1 vs t0") %>%
    # INTERACTIONS (drop the "CELIAC" word)
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.Status.*:onset_timeline_combined", "Dx × TP: ") %>%
    # MAIN Dx
    stringr::str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC$", paste0("Dx: CELIAC (vs ", ref_dx, ")")) %>%
    # OTHER COVARIATES (your set)
    stringr::str_replace("^SexMale$", "Sex: Male (vs Female)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryHigh Risk$", "HLA: High Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryLow/No Risk$", "HLA: Low/No Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearFormula$", "Feeding: Formula (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^feeding_first_yearBreastmilk_and_formula$", "Feeding: Mixed (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Delivery\\.ModeC-Section$", "Delivery: C-Section (vs Vaginal)") %>%
    stringr::str_replace("^Age\\.at\\.Gluten\\.Introduction\\.\\.months\\.$", "Age at gluten intro (months)")
}

# ---------- Standardize emmeans output ----------
emm_summary_df <- function(emm_contrast) {
  s <- as_tibble(summary(emm_contrast, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s))) {
    ci <- as_tibble(confint(emm_contrast))
    by_keys <- intersect(names(ci), names(s))
    s <- left_join(s, select(ci, any_of(c(by_keys, "lower.CL", "upper.CL"))), by = by_keys)
  }
  if (!all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(s)) && all(c("estimate","SE") %in% names(s))) {
    s <- mutate(s, lower.CL = estimate - 1.96*SE, upper.CL = estimate + 1.96*SE)
  }
  s
}

# ---------- Helpers to build contrast tables ----------
# A) TP vs t0 within a Dx level (we'll use for CONTROL)
tp_vs_t0_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = which(tp_levels == "t0"))
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    mutate(
      lhs = str_trim(str_remove(contrast, " - t0$")),
      rhs = "t0",
      term_label = paste0("TP (", dx_level, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
      section = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels)
    )
}

# B) Adjacent timepoint contrasts within a Dx level (enforce exact adjacency)
tp_adjacent_tbl <- function(fit, dx_level, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ onset_timeline_combined | Dx.Status,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )

  out <- contrast(emm, method = "consec")              # consecutive diffs in tp_levels order
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)                           # ensures we have lower.CL/upper.CL

  s %>%
    dplyr::filter(Dx.Status == dx_level) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # emmeans names are like "t0-12 - t0-6" → convert to "t0-12 vs t0-6"
      term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx_level, "): ",
                          stringr::str_replace(contrast, "\\s-\\s", " vs ")),
      section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
      # extract lhs/rhs for ordering keys
      lhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "^[^\\-]+") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      rhs = stringr::str_extract(contrast, "(?<=-)\\s*.*$") |> stringr::str_trim(),
      lhs_key = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
      # simple within-group running index (1 = t0-6 vs t0, 2 = t0-12 vs t0-6, …)
      adj_index = dplyr::row_number()
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(conf.low = lower.CL, conf.high = upper.CL)
}


# C) Between-group (CONTROL vs CELIAC) at each timepoint
dx_by_tp_tbl <- function(fit, tp_levels, type_link = TRUE) {
  emm <- emmeans(
    fit, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined,
    at   = list(onset_timeline_combined = tp_levels),
    type = if (type_link) "link" else "response"
  )
  out <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  s   <- emm_summary_df(out)

  s %>%
    filter(str_detect(contrast, "CELIAC\\s*-\\s*CONTROL")) %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", onset_timeline_combined),
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      lhs_key    = factor(onset_timeline_combined, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
}

# D) Fixed terms (tidy)
fixed_terms_tbl <- function(fit, model_label) {
  tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      term_label = pretty_label(term, ref_dx = "CELIAC"),
      section    = "Fixed terms",
      model      = model_label
    ) %>%
    select(model, section, term_label, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
}

# ---------- Master builder for ONE fit ----------
build_all_sections <- function(fit, model_label,
                               tp_levels,
                               dx_levels_vst0 = "CONTROL",                 # CONTROL vs t0
                               dx_levels_adj  = c("CELIAC","CONTROL"),     # adjacent for both
                               type_link = TRUE, p_adjust = "BH") {

  # --- fixed terms (already have conf.low/conf.high) ---
  fixed_tbl <- fixed_terms_tbl(fit, model_label) %>%
    mutate(source = "fixed")

  # --- emmeans tables ---
  vs_t0_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_vst0, ~ tp_vs_t0_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  adj_tbl   <- purrr::map_dfr(dx_levels_adj,  ~ tp_adjacent_tbl(fit, .x, tp_levels, type_link))
  dx_tp_tbl <- dx_by_tp_tbl(fit, tp_levels, type_link)

  # Standardize column names for all emmeans outputs
  std_emm <- function(df) {
    df %>%
      # emmeans gives lower.CL / upper.CL; rename to the plotting names
      dplyr::rename(conf.low  = dplyr::any_of("lower.CL"),
                    conf.high = dplyr::any_of("upper.CL")) %>%
      # keep required columns (others are kept if present)
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(
        "section","term_label","estimate","conf.low","conf.high","p.value",
        "lhs_key","rhs_key","adj_index"
      )), dplyr::everything())
  }

  emm_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    std_emm(vs_t0_tbl),
    std_emm(adj_tbl),
    std_emm(dx_tp_tbl)
  ) %>%
    mutate(source = "emmeans")

  # --- combine & compute FDR inside each model×section ---
  res <- dplyr::bind_rows(fixed_tbl, emm_tbl) %>%
    mutate(model = model_label) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(model, section) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = p_adjust),
                  sig   = p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # ensure helpers exist for ordering (used later)
  if (!"adj_index" %in% names(res)) res$adj_index <- NA_integer_
  if (!"lhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$lhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)
  if (!"rhs_key"   %in% names(res)) res$rhs_key   <- factor(NA, levels = tp_levels)

  res
}


# ---------- Build data for BOTH models ----------
dat_all <- bind_rows(
  build_all_sections(fit_shan, model_label = "Shannon",               tp_levels = tp_levels),
  build_all_sections(fit_obs,  model_label = "Observed (link scale)", tp_levels = tp_levels)
)

# Ensure ordering helpers exist

# Final label normalizations (safety)

    term_label = str_replace(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL ×", "Dx ×")

# Helper to extract a TP token from any label
extract_tp <- function(x) str_extract(x, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0")

  ) %>%
  arrange(
```

# Compositional analysis selfmade - Beta


# total - fit the model
```{r}

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(MDMR)

set.seed(123)
# ---- Inputs ----
counts <- total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta   <- total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Align samples
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta$sample_id)
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta   <- meta  %>% filter(sample_id %in% common)

# Bray–Curtis on relative abundances
X        <- t(counts)  # samples x ORFs
row_sums <- rowSums(X)
X_rel    <- sweep(X, 1, pmax(row_sums, 1e-12), "/")
D_bray   <- vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")

# Reorder metadata to match distance matrix
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
meta    <- meta %>% slice(match(ord_ids, sample_id))

# Coerce factors (important)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    Country = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Country), "ITALY"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
  D    = D_bray,
  use.ssd = 0.99,   # set to 1.00 if you prefer full SSD (slower)
  ncores = 1        # >1 uses forking; keep 1 on Windows
)
```

```{r}

# ===== Run this AFTER you built D_bray and meta =====
library(permute)   # for restricted permutations within patient
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# Small helper to build a formula like D_sub ~ <rhs>
fmla_from_rhs <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("D_sub ~", rhs))

library(permute)

# Build formula like: D_sub ~ <rhs>
fmla_from_rhs <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste("D_sub ~", rhs))

adonis_on_subset <- function(D, ds, rhs, term, nperm = 999) {
  # Guard 1: need at least 2 samples
  if (nrow(ds) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  ids <- ds$sample_id
  # Guard 2: distance submatrix must be at least 2x2
  if (length(ids) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D)[ids, ids])

  # Guard 3: tested term must have ≥2 levels
  if (!(term %in% names(ds)) || n_distinct(ds[[term]]) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  # Choose permutation scheme safely
  has_blocks <- "patientID" %in% names(ds) && n_distinct(ds$patientID) >= 2
  any_block_has_rep <- has_blocks && any(table(ds$patientID) >= 2)
  perm_scheme <- if (has_blocks && any_block_has_rep) {
    # restrict within patient when it makes sense
    how(blocks = droplevels(ds$patientID))
  } else {
    # fall back to free permutations
    nperm
  }

  fit <- adonis2(
    fmla_from_rhs(rhs),
    data         = ds,
    permutations = perm_scheme,
    by           = "margin"
  )

  tb <- as.data.frame(fit)
  if (!(term %in% rownames(tb))) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  tibble(
    term    = term,
    R2      = tb[term, "R2", drop = TRUE],
    F       = tb[term, "F",  drop = TRUE],
    p.value = tb[term, "Pr(>F)", drop = TRUE]
  )
}


# 1) Between groups at each TP
between_tp <- map_dfr(tp_levels, function(tp) {
  ds <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp)
  if (n_distinct(ds$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)
  adonis_on_subset(
    D_bray, ds,
    rhs  = "Dx.Status + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
            HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
    term = "Dx.Status"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", tp),
      lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
})

# 2) TP vs t0 within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
tp_vs_t0 <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  map_dfr(tp_levels[-1], function(tp) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c("t0", tp))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("TP (", dx, "): ", tp, " vs t0"),
        lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor("t0", levels = tp_levels)
      )
  })
})

# 3) Adjacent TP within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
adjacent_pairs <- tibble(lhs = tp_levels[-1], rhs = tp_levels[-length(tp_levels)])
tp_adjacent <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  pmap_dfr(adjacent_pairs, function(lhs, rhs) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c(lhs, rhs))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
        lhs_key    = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
        adj_index  = match(lhs, tp_levels)  # 2..n to enforce order
      )
  })
})

# 4) Global model (Dx × TP and covariates)
{
  ds    <- meta
  ids   <- ds$sample_id
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D_bray)[ids, ids])
  fit_global <- adonis2(
    D_sub ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex +
             Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
             HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode,
    data         = ds,
    permutations = how(blocks = ds$patientID),
    by           = "margin"
  )
  global_terms <- as.data.frame(fit_global) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      R2, F,
      p.value = `Pr(>F)`,
      section = "Fixed terms",
      term_label = case_when(
        term == "Dx.Status:onset_timeline_combined" ~ "Dx × TP (global)",
        term == "Dx.Status"                         ~ "Dx: CONTROL (vs CELIAC) (global)",
        term == "onset_timeline_combined"           ~ "TP (global)",
        term == "Country"                           ~ "Country (global)",
        term == "Sex"                               ~ "Sex (global)",
        term == "Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months." ~ "Age at gluten intro (months) (global)",
        term == "HLA.Category"                      ~ "HLA category (global)",
        term == "feeding_first_year"                ~ "Feeding (global)",
        term == "Delivery.Mode"                     ~ "Delivery mode (global)",
        TRUE ~ term
      )
    )
}

# Combine all, set blocks & ordering to mirror alpha plot style
dat_beta <- bind_rows(between_tp, tp_vs_t0, tp_adjacent, global_terms) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = R2,
    conf.low = NA_real_,            # no CIs from permutation MANOVA
    conf.high= NA_real_,
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    sig   = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05,
    model = "Bray–Curtis (R² effect size)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                               ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):")  ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")    ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms" & term_label == "Dx × TP (global)"                           ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms" & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                              ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                                  ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    )),
    # order within blocks
    tp_token = str_extract(term_label, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0"),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    block,
    if_else(!is.na(adj_index), as.double(adj_index), Inf),  # enforce adjacent order
    as.numeric(tp_key),
    term_label
  ) %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot (partial R²; reference line at 0)
total_contig_p_beta <- ggplot(dat_beta, aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Bray–Curtis β-diversity: timepoint contrasts, group differences, interactions, covariates",
    subtitle = "Effect size = partial R² from permutation MANOVA (adonis2 with permutations restricted within patientID).",
    x = "Effect size (partial R²)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; CIs not shown for permutation MANOVA."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
    strip.background.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# US - fit the model
```{r}

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(MDMR)

set.seed(123)
# ---- Inputs ----
counts <- US.contig.abundance.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta   <- US.contig.metadata.clean_0.75 %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Align samples
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta$sample_id)
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta   <- meta  %>% filter(sample_id %in% common)

# Bray–Curtis on relative abundances
X        <- t(counts)  # samples x ORFs
row_sums <- rowSums(X)
X_rel    <- sweep(X, 1, pmax(row_sums, 1e-12), "/")
D_bray   <- vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")

# Reorder metadata to match distance matrix
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
meta    <- meta %>% slice(match(ord_ids, sample_id))

# Coerce factors (important)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
  D    = D_bray,
  use.ssd = 0.99,   # set to 1.00 if you prefer full SSD (slower)
  ncores = 1        # >1 uses forking; keep 1 on Windows
)




```

```{r}
  # Guard 1: need at least 2 samples
  if (nrow(ds) < 2) {

    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))

  any_block_has_rep <- has_blocks && any(table(ds$patientID) >= 2)
  perm_scheme <- if (has_blocks && any_block_has_rep) {
    # restrict within patient when it makes sense
    how(blocks = droplevels(ds$patientID))
  } else {
    # fall back to free permutations
    nperm
  }

  fit <- adonis2(
    fmla_from_rhs(rhs),
    data         = ds,
    permutations = perm_scheme,
    by           = "margin"
  )

  tb <- as.data.frame(fit)
  if (!(term %in% rownames(tb))) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  tibble(
    term    = term,
    R2      = tb[term, "R2", drop = TRUE],
    F       = tb[term, "F",  drop = TRUE],
    p.value = tb[term, "Pr(>F)", drop = TRUE]
  )
}
```

```{r}
  }

  ids <- ds$sample_id
  # Guard 2: distance submatrix must be at least 2x2
  if (length(ids) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D)[ids, ids])

  # Guard 3: tested term must have ≥2 levels
  if (!(term %in% names(ds)) || n_distinct(ds[[term]]) < 2) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  # Choose permutation scheme safely
  has_blocks <- "patientID" %in% names(ds) && n_distinct(ds$patientID) >= 2
  any_block_has_rep <- has_blocks && any(table(ds$patientID) >= 2)
  perm_scheme <- if (has_blocks && any_block_has_rep) {
    # restrict within patient when it makes sense
    how(blocks = droplevels(ds$patientID))
  } else {
    # fall back to free permutations
    nperm
  }

  fit <- adonis2(
    fmla_from_rhs(rhs),
    data         = ds,
    permutations = perm_scheme,
    by           = "margin"
  )

  tb <- as.data.frame(fit)
  if (!(term %in% rownames(tb))) {
    return(tibble(term = term, R2 = NA_real_, F = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  tibble(
    term    = term,
    R2      = tb[term, "R2", drop = TRUE],
    F       = tb[term, "F",  drop = TRUE],
    p.value = tb[term, "Pr(>F)", drop = TRUE]
  )
}


# 1) Between groups at each TP
between_tp <- map_dfr(tp_levels, function(tp) {
  ds <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp)
  if (n_distinct(ds$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)
  adonis_on_subset(
    D_bray, ds,
    rhs  = "Dx.Status + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
            HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
    term = "Dx.Status"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      section    = "Between groups at each TP",
      term_label = paste0("CONTROL vs CELIAC @ ", tp),
      lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
      rhs_key    = lhs_key
    )
})

# 2) TP vs t0 within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
#tp_vs_t0 <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  map_dfr(tp_levels[-1], function(tp) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c("t0", tp))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("TP (", dx, "): ", tp, " vs t0"),
        lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor("t0", levels = tp_levels)
      )
  })
})

tp_vs_t0 <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {

    map_dfr(tp_levels[-1], function(tp) {

      ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                            onset_timeline_combined %in% c("t0", tp))

      if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)

      # Check sample counts
      tp_counts <- ds %>% count(onset_timeline_combined) %>% pull(n)
      if (any(tp_counts < 2) || nrow(ds) < 4) {
        message(sprintf("Skipping %s: %s vs t0 - insufficient samples", dx, tp))
        return(NULL)
      }

      # Try-catch for remaining edge cases
      tryCatch({
        adonis_on_subset(
          D_bray,
          ds,
          rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
                  HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
          term = "onset_timeline_combined"
        ) %>%
          mutate(
            section    = "TP vs t0 (within group)",
            term_label = paste0("TP (", dx, "): ", tp, " vs t0"),
            lhs_key    = factor(tp, levels = tp_levels),
            rhs_key    = factor("t0", levels = tp_levels)
          )
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("Error in %s: %s vs t0 - %s", dx, tp, e$message))
        return(NULL)
      })

    })
  })

# 3) Adjacent TP within group (CONTROL and CELIAC)
adjacent_pairs <- tibble(lhs = tp_levels[-1], rhs = tp_levels[-length(tp_levels)])
tp_adjacent <- map_dfr(c("CONTROL","CELIAC"), function(dx) {
  pmap_dfr(adjacent_pairs, function(lhs, rhs) {
    ds <- meta %>% filter(Dx.Status == dx,
                          onset_timeline_combined %in% c(lhs, rhs))
    if (n_distinct(ds$onset_timeline_combined) < 2) return(NULL)
    adonis_on_subset(
      D_bray, ds,
      rhs  = "onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
              HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode",
      term = "onset_timeline_combined"
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        section    = "Adjacent TP (within group)",
        term_label = paste0("Adjacent (", dx, "): ", lhs, " vs ", rhs),
        lhs_key    = factor(lhs, levels = tp_levels),
        rhs_key    = factor(rhs, levels = tp_levels),
        adj_index  = match(lhs, tp_levels)  # 2..n to enforce order
      )
  })
})

# 4) Global model (Dx × TP and covariates)
{
  ds    <- meta
  ids   <- ds$sample_id
  D_sub <- as.dist(as.matrix(D_bray)[ids, ids])
  fit_global <- adonis2(
    D_sub ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex +
             Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
             HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode,
    data         = ds,
    permutations = how(blocks = ds$patientID),
    by           = "margin"
  )
  global_terms <- as.data.frame(fit_global) %>%
    rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    transmute(
      term,
      R2, F,
      p.value = `Pr(>F)`,
      section = "Fixed terms",
      term_label = case_when(
        term == "Dx.Status:onset_timeline_combined" ~ "Dx × TP (global)",
        term == "Dx.Status"                         ~ "Dx: CONTROL (vs CELIAC) (global)",
        term == "onset_timeline_combined"           ~ "TP (global)",
        term == "Sex"                               ~ "Sex (global)",
        term == "Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months." ~ "Age at gluten intro (months) (global)",
        term == "HLA.Category"                      ~ "HLA category (global)",
        term == "feeding_first_year"                ~ "Feeding (global)",
        term == "Delivery.Mode"                     ~ "Delivery mode (global)",
        TRUE ~ term
      )
    )
}

# Combine all, set blocks & ordering to mirror alpha plot style
dat_beta <- bind_rows(between_tp, tp_vs_t0, tp_adjacent, global_terms) %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = R2,
    conf.low = NA_real_,            # no CIs from permutation MANOVA
    conf.high= NA_real_,
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    sig   = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05,
    model = "Bray–Curtis (R² effect size)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = case_when(
      section == "Between groups at each TP"                                               ~ "Between groups at each TP",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CONTROL\\):")  ~ "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      section == "TP vs t0 (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "^TP \\(CELIAC\\):")   ~ "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CONTROL\\)")    ~ "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      section == "Adjacent TP (within group)" & str_detect(term_label, "\\(CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      section == "Fixed terms" & term_label == "Dx × TP (global)"                           ~ "Dx × TP interactions",
      section == "Fixed terms" & str_detect(term_label, "^Dx: CONTROL \\(vs CELIAC\\)")     ~ "Dx main effect",
      section == "Fixed terms"                                                              ~ "Other covariates",
      TRUE                                                                                  ~ "Other covariates"
    ),
    block = factor(block, levels = c(
      "Between groups at each TP",
      "TP vs t0 (CONTROL)",
      "TP vs t0 (CELIAC)",
      "Adjacent TP (CONTROL)",
      "Adjacent TP (CELIAC)",
      "Dx × TP interactions",
      "Dx main effect",
      "Other covariates"
    )),
    # order within blocks
    tp_token = str_extract(term_label, "t0(?:-(?:\\d+|over\\d+))?|t0"),
    tp_key   = factor(tp_token, levels = tp_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    block,
    if_else(!is.na(adj_index), as.double(adj_index), Inf),  # enforce adjacent order
    as.numeric(tp_key),
    term_label
  ) %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(term_label = forcats::fct_relevel(term_label, unique(term_label))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot (partial R²; reference line at 0)
Italy_contig_p_beta <- ggplot(dat_beta, aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(block ~ model, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Bray–Curtis β-diversity: timepoint contrasts, group differences, interactions, covariates",
    subtitle = "Effect size = partial R² from permutation MANOVA (adonis2 with permutations restricted within patientID).",
    x = "Effect size (partial R²)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05; CIs not shown for permutation MANOVA."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),        # hide right-side facet labels
    strip.background.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

# Compositional analysis selfmade - Alpha

# total - per time point contrast
```{r}

# ── Packages ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(glmmTMB)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)

# ── 0) Inputs: counts + metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# counts: rows=contigs (features), cols=samples (counts)
count_mat <- total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta_df   <- total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame()

stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(count_mat)), !is.null(colnames(count_mat)))
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(meta_df)))

# align by common samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_mat), rownames(meta_df))
count_mat <- count_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
meta_df   <- meta_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ── 1) Build phyloseq (no tree needed) ────────────────────────────────────────
OTU <- otu_table(count_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
SAM <- sample_data(meta_df)
ps  <- phyloseq(OTU, SAM)

# exposure / library size (replace with effective lib size if you have it)
lib_size <- sample_sums(ps)
sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize <- as.numeric(lib_size)
sample_data(ps)$offset_log  <- log(pmax(sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize, 1))

# ── 2) Alpha diversity per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_samp_taxa <- t(otu_table(ps))                    # samples x taxa
observed <- vegan::specnumber(otu_samp_taxa)
shannon  <- vegan::diversity(otu_samp_taxa, index = "shannon")

alpha_tbl <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(observed),
  Observed  = as.numeric(observed),
  Shannon   = as.numeric(shannon)
)


alpha_all <- alpha_tbl %>%
  left_join(meta_df %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eff_libsize = as.numeric(lib_size[sample_id]),
    offset_log  = log(pmax(eff_libsize, 1)),
    # factors to match your other models
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Country = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Country), "ITALY"),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Dx.Status, onset_timeline_combined, patientID)


# ── 3) GLOBAL models (same structure as PA/abundance) ─────────────────────────
# Observed richness ~ NB with offset + random intercept
fit_obs <- glmmTMB(
  Observed ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined +
    Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID) + offset(offset_log),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = alpha_all
)



# Shannon ~ Gaussian LMM with random intercept
fit_shan <- glmmTMB(
  Shannon ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined +
    Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID),
  family = gaussian(),   # <- key change
  data = alpha_all
)

library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)

# Observed richness: hold offset at 0 so contrasts are rate ratios (IRR)
rg_obs <- ref_grid(fit_obs, at = list(offset_log = 0))
emm_obs <- emmeans(rg_obs, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined)
ctr_obs <- contrast(emm_obs, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none")

# Shannon diversity: Gaussian GLMM, direct emmeans
emm_shan <- emmeans(fit_shan, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined)
ctr_shan <- contrast(emm_shan, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none")



# Observed: log(IRR), plus exponentiated IRR
sum_obs <- as_tibble(summary(ctr_obs, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(confint(ctr_obs)) %>%
              select(contrast, onset_timeline_combined),
            by = c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined")) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = "Observed",
    IRR      = exp(estimate),
    IRR.low  = exp(asymp.LCL),
    IRR.high = exp(asymp.UCL)
  )


# Shannon: difference in mean Shannon between groups
sum_shan <- as_tibble(summary(ctr_shan, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(confint(ctr_shan)) %>%
              select(contrast, onset_timeline_combined),
            by = c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined")) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Shannon")


# Combine results and adjust p-values
alpha_contrasts <- bind_rows(sum_obs, sum_shan) %>%
  filter(grepl("CELIAC", contrast) & grepl("CONTROL", contrast)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(timepoint = onset_timeline_combined) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()


# make plot for Observed
total_observed_contrast <- alpha_contrasts %>%
  filter(metric == "Observed") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint)),
    sig = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = timepoint, x = IRR)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = IRR.low, xmax = IRR.high), height = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "IRR (CONTROL vs CELIAC)",
    y = "Timepoint",
    title = "Total Observed richness: per-timepoint IRR with 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(total_observed_contrast,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/total_contig_observed_contrast.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 6,height=6)



# make plot for Observed
total_shannon_contrast <- alpha_contrasts %>%
  filter(metric == "Shannon") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint)),
    sig = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = timepoint, x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower.CL, xmax = upper.CL), height = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Shannon difference (CONTROL vs CELIAC)",
    y = "Timepoint",
    title = "Total Shannon diversity: per-timepoint difference with 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# total - all terms
```{r}

library(broom.mixed)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

# --- 1) Tidy all fixed effects (exclude intercept & RE summaries) -------------
tidy_all_shan <- tidy(fit_shan, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(model = "Shannon")

tidy_all_obs <- tidy(fit_obs, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(model = "Observed (log scale)",
         IRR = exp(estimate),
         IRR.low  = exp(conf.low),
         IRR.high = exp(conf.high))

# --- 2) Combine and compute BH FDR within each model --------------------------
all_terms <- bind_rows(tidy_all_shan, tidy_all_obs) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sig = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05)


# --- 3) Make human-friendly term labels ---------------------------------------
pretty_label <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    # Interaction first (keep it readable)
    str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC:onset_timeline_combined", "Dx: CELIAC × TP: ") %>%
    # Main effects for the interaction components
    str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC$", "Dx: CELIAC (vs CONTROL)") %>%
    str_replace("^onset_timeline_combined", "TP: ") %>%
    # Other categorical covariates (adjust names if your levels differ)
    str_replace("^SexMale$", "Sex: Male (vs Female)") %>%
    str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryHigh Risk$", "HLA: High Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryLow/No Risk$", "HLA: Low/No Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    str_replace("^feeding_first_yearFormula$", "Feeding: Formula (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    str_replace("^feeding_first_yearBreastmilk_and_formula$", "Feeding: Mixed (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    str_replace("^Delivery\\.ModeC-Section$", "Delivery: C-Section (vs Vaginal)") %>%
    # Continuous covariate
    str_replace("^Age\\.at\\.Gluten\\.Introduction\\.\\.months\\.$", "Age at gluten intro (months)")
}


all_terms <- all_terms %>%
  mutate(term_label = pretty_label(term))

# Optional: order terms in logical groups (interactions, then mains, then others)
all_terms <- all_terms %>%
  mutate(group =
           case_when(
             str_detect(term, "^Dx\\.Status.*:onset_timeline_combined") ~ "Interaction: Dx × TP",
             str_detect(term, "^onset_timeline_combined")               ~ "Main: Timepoint (vs baseline)",
             str_detect(term, "^Dx\\.Status")                            ~ "Main: Dx",
             TRUE                                                        ~ "Other covariates"
           ))



# 1) Define the desired panel order for 'group'
group_levels <- c(
  "Interaction: Dx × TP",
  "Main: Timepoint (vs baseline)",
  "Main: Dx",
  "Other covariates"
)

# 2) Build stable ordering keys first, then arrange
all_terms <- all_terms %>%
  # make sure term_label is plain character for ordering
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_levels),
    term_label = as.character(term_label),
    .by = NULL
  ) %>%
  arrange(model, group, term_label) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  # now freeze the y-axis order within each model
  mutate(term_label = factor(term_label, levels = unique(term_label))) %>%
  ungroup()



# --- 4) Forest plots ----------------------------------------------------------
## A) Shannon (difference; 0 = no effect)
total_contig_shannon_allTerms <- all_terms %>%
  filter(model == "Shannon") %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.22) +
  geom_point(aes(color = p.adj < 0.05), size = 2.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Total Shannon diversity — all fixed terms",
    x = "Estimate (difference in Shannon)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))

## B) Observed richness (log scale; 0 = no effect)
```

```{r}


# ── 0) Inputs: counts + metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# counts: rows=contigs (features), cols=samples (counts)
count_mat <- US.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta_df   <- US.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame()

stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(count_mat)), !is.null(colnames(count_mat)))
stopifnot(!is.null(rownames(meta_df)))

# align by common samples
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(count_mat), rownames(meta_df))
count_mat <- count_mat[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]
meta_df   <- meta_df[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

# ── 1) Build phyloseq (no tree needed) ────────────────────────────────────────
OTU <- otu_table(count_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
SAM <- sample_data(meta_df)
ps  <- phyloseq(OTU, SAM)

# exposure / library size (replace with effective lib size if you have it)
lib_size <- sample_sums(ps)
sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize <- as.numeric(lib_size)
sample_data(ps)$offset_log  <- log(pmax(sample_data(ps)$eff_libsize, 1))

# ── 2) Alpha diversity per sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_samp_taxa <- t(otu_table(ps))                    # samples x taxa
observed <- vegan::specnumber(otu_samp_taxa)
shannon  <- vegan::diversity(otu_samp_taxa, index = "shannon")

alpha_tbl <- tibble(
  sample_id = names(observed),
  Observed  = as.numeric(observed),
  Shannon   = as.numeric(shannon)
)


alpha_all <- alpha_tbl %>%
  left_join(meta_df %>% rownames_to_column("sample_id"), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eff_libsize = as.numeric(lib_size[sample_id]),
    offset_log  = log(pmax(eff_libsize, 1)),
    # factors to match your other models
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Dx.Status, onset_timeline_combined, patientID)


# ── 3) GLOBAL models (same structure as PA/abundance) ─────────────────────────
# Observed richness ~ NB with offset + random intercept
fit_obs <- glmmTMB(
  Observed ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID) + offset(offset_log),
  family = nbinom2,
  data = alpha_all
)

# Shannon ~ Gaussian LMM with random intercept
fit_shan <- glmmTMB(
  Shannon ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
    HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode +
    (1 | patientID),
  family = gaussian(),   # <- key change
  data = alpha_all
)

library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)

# Observed richness: hold offset at 0 so contrasts are rate ratios (IRR)
rg_obs <- ref_grid(fit_obs, at = list(offset_log = 0))
emm_obs <- emmeans(rg_obs, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined)
ctr_obs <- contrast(emm_obs, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none")

# Shannon diversity: Gaussian GLMM, direct emmeans
emm_shan <- emmeans(fit_shan, ~ Dx.Status | onset_timeline_combined)
ctr_shan <- contrast(emm_shan, method = "revpairwise", by = "onset_timeline_combined", adjust = "none")



# Observed: log(IRR), plus exponentiated IRR
sum_obs <- as_tibble(summary(ctr_obs, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(confint(ctr_obs)) %>%
              select(contrast, onset_timeline_combined),
            by = c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined")) %>%
  mutate(
    metric = "Observed",
    IRR      = exp(estimate),
    IRR.low  = exp(asymp.LCL),
    IRR.high = exp(asymp.UCL)
  )


# Shannon: difference in mean Shannon between groups
sum_shan <- as_tibble(summary(ctr_shan, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))) %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(confint(ctr_shan)) %>%
              select(contrast, onset_timeline_combined),
            by = c("contrast","onset_timeline_combined")) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Shannon")


# Combine results and adjust p-values
alpha_contrasts <- bind_rows(sum_obs, sum_shan) %>%
  filter(grepl("CELIAC", contrast) & grepl("CONTROL", contrast)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(timepoint = onset_timeline_combined) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()


# make plot for Observed
US_observed_contrast <- alpha_contrasts %>%
  filter(metric == "Observed") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint)),
    sig = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = timepoint, x = IRR)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = IRR.low, xmax = IRR.high), height = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "IRR (CONTROL vs CELIAC)",
    y = "Timepoint",
    title = "US Observed richness: per-timepoint IRR with 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(US_observed_contrast,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/US_contig_observed_contrast.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 6,height=6)



# make plot for Observed
US_shannon_contrast <- alpha_contrasts %>%
  filter(metric == "Shannon") %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint)),
    sig = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = timepoint, x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower.CL, xmax = upper.CL), height = 0.25) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 2.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Shannon difference (CONTROL vs CELIAC)",
    y = "Timepoint",
    title = "US Shannon diversity: per-timepoint difference with 95% CI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(US_shannon_contrast,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/US_contig_shannon_contrast.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 6,height=6)
```

# US - all terms
```{r}

# --- 1) Tidy all fixed effects (exclude intercept & RE summaries) -------------
tidy_all_shan <- tidy(fit_shan, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(model = "Shannon")

tidy_all_obs <- tidy(fit_obs, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(model = "Observed (log scale)",
         IRR = exp(estimate),
         IRR.low  = exp(conf.low),
         IRR.high = exp(conf.high))

# --- 2) Combine and compute BH FDR within each model --------------------------
all_terms <- bind_rows(tidy_all_shan, tidy_all_obs) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sig = !is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05)


# --- 3) Make human-friendly term labels ---------------------------------------
pretty_label <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    # Interaction first (keep it readable)
    str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC:onset_timeline_combined", "Dx: CELIAC × TP: ") %>%
    # Main effects for the interaction components
    str_replace("^Dx\\.StatusCELIAC$", "Dx: CELIAC (vs CONTROL)") %>%
    str_replace("^onset_timeline_combined", "TP: ") %>%
    # Other categorical covariates (adjust names if your levels differ)
    str_replace("^SexMale$", "Sex: Male (vs Female)") %>%
    str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryHigh Risk$", "HLA: High Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    str_replace("^HLA\\.CategoryLow/No Risk$", "HLA: Low/No Risk (vs Ref)") %>%
    str_replace("^feeding_first_yearFormula$", "Feeding: Formula (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    str_replace("^feeding_first_yearBreastmilk_and_formula$", "Feeding: Mixed (vs Breastmilk)") %>%
    str_replace("^Delivery\\.ModeC-Section$", "Delivery: C-Section (vs Vaginal)") %>%
    # Continuous covariate
    str_replace("^Age\\.at\\.Gluten\\.Introduction\\.\\.months\\.$", "Age at gluten intro (months)")
}


all_terms <- all_terms %>%
  mutate(term_label = pretty_label(term))

# Optional: order terms in logical groups (interactions, then mains, then others)
all_terms <- all_terms %>%
  mutate(group =
           case_when(
             str_detect(term, "^Dx\\.Status.*:onset_timeline_combined") ~ "Interaction: Dx × TP",
             str_detect(term, "^onset_timeline_combined")               ~ "Main: Timepoint (vs baseline)",
             str_detect(term, "^Dx\\.Status")                            ~ "Main: Dx",
             TRUE                                                        ~ "Other covariates"
           ))



# 1) Define the desired panel order for 'group'
group_levels <- c(
  "Interaction: Dx × TP",
  "Main: Timepoint (vs baseline)",
  "Main: Dx",
  "Other covariates"
)

# 2) Build stable ordering keys first, then arrange
all_terms <- all_terms %>%
  # make sure term_label is plain character for ordering
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_levels),
    term_label = as.character(term_label),
    .by = NULL
  ) %>%
  arrange(model, group, term_label) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  # now freeze the y-axis order within each model
  mutate(term_label = factor(term_label, levels = unique(term_label))) %>%
  ungroup()



# --- 4) Forest plots ----------------------------------------------------------
## A) Shannon (difference; 0 = no effect)
US_contig_shannon_allTerms <- all_terms %>%
  filter(model == "Shannon") %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.22) +
  geom_point(aes(color = p.adj < 0.05), size = 2.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "US Shannon diversity — all fixed terms",
    x = "Estimate (difference in Shannon)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(US_contig_shannon_allTerms,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/US_contig_shannon_allTerms.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 6,height=12)


## B) Observed richness (log scale; 0 = no effect)
US_contig_observed_allTerms <- all_terms %>%
  filter(model == "Observed (log scale)") %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = fct_rev(term_label), x = estimate)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.22) +
  geom_point(aes(color = p.adj < 0.05), size = 2.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "US Observed richness — all fixed terms",
    x = "Estimate (log rate ratio)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Red: BH FDR < 0.05"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))


ggsave(US_contig_observed_allTerms,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/US_contig_observed_allTerms.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 6,height=12)
```

# Compositional analysis selfmade - Beta

# total - per timepoint contrast
```{r}


# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(MDMR)

# ---- Inputs ----
counts <- total.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta   <- total.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Align samples
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta$sample_id)
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta   <- meta  %>% filter(sample_id %in% common)

# Bray–Curtis on relative abundances
X        <- t(counts)  # samples x ORFs
row_sums <- rowSums(X)
X_rel    <- sweep(X, 1, pmax(row_sums, 1e-12), "/")
D_bray   <- vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")

# Reorder metadata to match distance matrix
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
meta    <- meta %>% slice(match(ord_ids, sample_id))

# Coerce factors (important)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    Country = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Country), "ITALY"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Country + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
  D    = D_bray,
  use.ssd = 0.99,   # set to 1.00 if you prefer full SSD (slower)
  ncores = 1        # >1 uses forking; keep 1 on Windows
)

# Results
res_tab <- summary(fit_mmdmr)           # Statistic, Numer DF, p-value per term
res_tab <- data.frame(res_tab) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(`p.value`, method = "BH"))



ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
stopifnot(identical(meta$sample_id, ord_ids))

# Helper that runs MDMR for ONE timepoint, adjusting for covariates
run_mdmr_tp <- function(tp, meta, D_full, ord_ids, use_perm_p = FALSE, nperm = 4999, seed = 1L) {
  print(tp)
  df <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp) %>% droplevels()
  if (nrow(df) < 3 || n_distinct(df$Dx.Status) < 2) {
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status", Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  idx <- match(df$sample_id, ord_ids)
  if (any(is.na(idx))) {
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status", Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  D_tp <- as.dist(as.matrix(D_full)[idx, idx, drop = FALSE])


  # Quick degeneracy check (all pairwise distances == 0)
  M <- as.matrix(D_tp); U <- upper.tri(M, diag = FALSE)
  if (!any(U) || all(M[U] == 0)) {
    print("test")
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status",
                  Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  # Build X as a DATA FRAME with factors kept as factors
  X_df <- df %>%
    transmute(
      Dx.Status = factor(Dx.Status),
      Country = factor(Country),
      Sex = factor(Sex),
      Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.),
      HLA.Category = factor(HLA.Category),
      feeding_first_year = factor(feeding_first_year),
      Delivery.Mode = factor(Delivery.Mode)
    )

  # mdmr() expects X= (matrix or data.frame) and D=/G=
  # Use analytic p-values by default; or set use_perm_p = TRUE for permutation p's
  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    MDMR::mdmr(
      X = X_df,
      D = D_tp,
      perm.p = use_perm_p,
      nperm = if (use_perm_p) nperm else 500  # ignored if perm.p=FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    print("fit is still null")
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status",
                  Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  
  sm <- data.frame(summary(fit)) %>%
        rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term == "Dx.Status1") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = tp) %>%
    select(timepoint,Statistic,Numer.DF,Pseudo.R2,Analytic.p.value)


}


# Run across timepoints (no random effect needed within TP)
tp_levels <- levels(meta$onset_timeline_combined)

per_tp_dx <- purrr::map_dfr(
  tp_levels,
  ~ run_mdmr_tp(.x, meta = meta, D_full = D_bray, ord_ids = ord_ids, use_perm_p = FALSE)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = ifelse(all(is.na(Analytic.p.value)), NA_real_, p.adjust(Analytic.p.value, method = "BH")))
```
