```{r}
# make plot
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)

# Assumes:
# D_bray : dist with rows/cols == meta$sample_id
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
stopifnot(identical(meta$sample_id, ord_ids))
meta <- droplevels(meta)

cap_one_tp <- function(tp, meta, D_full, ord_ids) {
  df <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp) %>% droplevels()
  if (nrow(df) < 3 || n_distinct(df$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)

  idx <- match(df$sample_id, ord_ids)
  if (any(is.na(idx))) return(NULL)

  subM <- as.matrix(D_full)[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
  U <- upper.tri(subM, diag = FALSE)
  if (!any(U) || all(subM[U] == 0)) return(NULL)  # degenerate

  D_tp <- as.dist(subM)

  # CAP with Dx constrained, covariates conditioned (partialled out)
  cap <- capscale(
    D_tp ~ Dx.Status +
      Condition(Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
                HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode),
    data = df,
    add = TRUE
  )

  # Permutation test for Dx (marginal)
  aov_dx <- tryCatch(anova(cap, by = "margin", permutations = 9999), error = function(e) NULL)
  p_dx   <- if (!is.null(aov_dx) && "Dx.Status" %in% rownames(aov_dx)) aov_dx["Dx.Status", "Pr(>F)"] else NA_real_

  # Scores (CAP1/2)
  scr <- scores(cap, display = "sites", choices = 1:2)
  CAP1 <- scr[, 1]
  CAP2 <- if (ncol(scr) >= 2) scr[, 2] else rep(0, length(CAP1))

  # % variance on constrained axes (for labels)
  eig <- cap$CCA$eig
  varex <- if (length(eig)) 100 * eig / sum(eig) else numeric(0)
  v1 <- if (length(varex) >= 1) varex[1] else NA_real_
  v2 <- if (length(varex) >= 2) varex[2] else NA_real_

  tibble(
    sample_id = df$sample_id,
    timepoint = as.character(tp),
    Dx.Status = df$Dx.Status,
    CAP1 = CAP1,
    CAP2 = CAP2,
    p_dx = p_dx,          # carry p with the rows (same value within TP)
    pct_CAP1 = v1,
    pct_CAP2 = v2
  )
}

tp_levels <- levels(meta$onset_timeline_combined)
if (is.null(tp_levels)) tp_levels <- unique(meta$onset_timeline_combined)

cap_list <- lapply(tp_levels, cap_one_tp, meta = meta, D_full = D_bray, ord_ids = ord_ids)
cap_df   <- bind_rows(cap_list)   # drops NULLs safely

# Make sure we actually have rows
stopifnot(nrow(cap_df) > 0)

tp_order <- c("t0","t0-6","t0-12","t0-18","t0-24","t0-30","t0-36","t0-over42")

# 1) Harmonize key type
## Rebuild per-TP FDR straight from cap_df (cap_df has one p_dx per TP carried on rows)
cap_df <- cap_df %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = tp_order))

p_tbl <- cap_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(timepoint, p_dx) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = ifelse(all(is.na(p_dx)), NA_real_, p.adjust(p_dx, method = "BH")))

## Axis labels (% variance) – median across TPs
pct_tbl <- cap_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(timepoint, pct_CAP1, pct_CAP2) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = tp_order))

lab_x <- sprintf("CAP1 (%.1f%%)", median(pct_tbl$pct_CAP1, na.rm = TRUE))
lab_y <- sprintf("CAP2 (%.1f%%)", median(pct_tbl$pct_CAP2, na.rm = TRUE))

## Label positions – MAKE SURE timepoint stays in the result
lab_pos <- cap_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    timepoint = dplyr::first(timepoint),   # <- keep the key explicitly
    x = max(CAP1, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(CAP2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(p_tbl, by = "timepoint") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = ifelse(
      is.finite(p.adj),
      sprintf("FDR = %.3g%s", p.adj, ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, " *", "")),
      "FDR = NA"
    )
  )

## Centroids (and group sizes) — qualify n()
centroids <- cap_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(timepoint, Dx.Status) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    cx = mean(CAP1),
    cy = mean(CAP2),
    n  = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Which timepoints have >=3 per Dx group for ellipses
tmp_counts <- cap_df %>% dplyr::count(timepoint, Dx.Status, name = "n")
tp_for_ellipse <- tmp_counts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ok = all(n >= 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(ok) %>%
  dplyr::pull(timepoint)

## Plot
total_contig_beta_contrast <- ggplot(cap_df, aes(CAP1, CAP2, color = Dx.Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_ellipse(
  data = subset(cap_df, timepoint %in% tp_for_ellipse),
  aes(group = Dx.Status),
  type = "t",
  level = 0.68,
  linewidth = 0.5,
  alpha = 0.18
) +
  geom_point(
    data = centroids, aes(cx, cy, color = Dx.Status),
    shape = 4, stroke = 1.2, size = 3, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ timepoint, scales = "free") +
  geom_text(
    data = lab_pos, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Total CAP (distance-based RDA) by timepoint",
    subtitle = "Dx.Status constrained; covariates conditioned. FDR = BH across timepoints",
    x = lab_x, y = lab_y, color = "Dx.Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


ggsave(total_contig_beta_contrast,file="~/Handley Lab Dropbox/16S/Celiac/Phage/phage_detection_pipeline_new_assembly/Virome/Orf_Contig_Phrog_compositional/orf_contig_results_figures/contig/total_contig_beta_contrast.pdf",dpi = 600,width = 10,height=10)
```

```{r}
# make plot
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
stopifnot(identical(meta$sample_id, ord_ids))
meta <- droplevels(meta)

cap_one_tp <- function(tp, meta, D_full, ord_ids, fallback_pcoa = TRUE) {
  df <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp) %>% droplevels()

  # need ≥ 3 samples total and ≥2 Dx groups
  if (nrow(df) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(df$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)

  idx <- match(df$sample_id, ord_ids)
  if (any(is.na(idx))) return(NULL)

  subM <- as.matrix(D_full)[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
  U <- upper.tri(subM, diag = FALSE)
  if (!any(U) || all(subM[U] == 0)) return(NULL)   # all distances 0 → degenerate

  D_tp <- as.dist(subM)

  # CAP: Dx constrained, covariates conditioned out
  cap <- tryCatch(
    vegan::capscale(
      D_tp ~ Dx.Status +
        Condition(Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
                  HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode),
      data = df, add = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(cap)) return(NULL)

  # Permutation test for Dx (marginal)
  aov_dx <- tryCatch(anova(cap, by = "margin", permutations = 9999),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
  p_dx <- if (!is.null(aov_dx) && "Dx.Status" %in% rownames(aov_dx)) {
    aov_dx["Dx.Status", "Pr(>F)"]
  } else NA_real_

  # If constrained rank is 0, optionally fall back to PCoA coords for plotting
  rank_con <- tryCatch(cap$CCA$rank, error = function(e) 0)
  if (is.na(rank_con)) rank_con <- 0

  if (rank_con < 1) {
    if (!fallback_pcoa) return(NULL)
    # PCoA (unconstrained) just to place points; keep p_dx for the label
    pcs <- tryCatch(cmdscale(D_tp, k = 2, eig = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(pcs)) return(NULL)
    CAP1 <- pcs$points[, 1]
    CAP2 <- if (ncol(pcs$points) >= 2) pcs$points[, 2] else rep(0, length(CAP1))
    v1 <- v2 <- NA_real_
  } else {
    # Safe score extraction
    scr <- tryCatch(scores(cap, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(scr)) return(NULL)
    scr <- as.matrix(scr)
    if (ncol(scr) < 1) return(NULL)
    CAP1 <- scr[, 1]
    CAP2 <- if (ncol(scr) >= 2) scr[, 2] else rep(0, length(CAP1))
    # % variance on constrained axes
    eig <- tryCatch(cap$CCA$eig, error = function(e) numeric(0))
    varex <- if (length(eig)) 100 * eig / sum(eig) else numeric(0)
    v1 <- if (length(varex) >= 1) varex[1] else NA_real_
    v2 <- if (length(varex) >= 2) varex[2] else NA_real_
  }

  tibble(
    sample_id = df$sample_id,
    timepoint = as.character(tp),
    Dx.Status = df$Dx.Status,
    CAP1 = CAP1,
    CAP2 = CAP2,
    p_dx = p_dx,
    pct_CAP1 = v1,
    pct_CAP2 = v2
  )
}


tp_levels <- levels(meta$onset_timeline_combined)
if (is.null(tp_levels)) tp_levels <- unique(meta$onset_timeline_combined)

cap_df   <- bind_rows(cap_list)   # drops NULLs safely

# Make sure we actually have rows
stopifnot(nrow(cap_df) > 0)

# 1) Harmonize key type

  dplyr::distinct(timepoint, p_dx) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = ifelse(all(is.na(p_dx)), NA_real_, p.adjust(p_dx, method = "BH")))

lab_y <- sprintf("CAP2 (%.1f%%)", median(pct_tbl$pct_CAP2, na.rm = TRUE))

    )
  )

) +

    subtitle = "Dx.Status constrained; covariates conditioned. FDR = BH across timepoints",
    x = lab_x, y = lab_y, color = "Dx.Status"
  ) +
```

```{r}

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(MDMR)

# ---- Inputs ----
counts <- Italy.contig.abundance.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame() %>% as.matrix()
meta   <- Italy.contig.metadata.clean_0.75_0.03 %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

# Align samples
common <- intersect(colnames(counts), meta$sample_id)
counts <- counts[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta   <- meta  %>% filter(sample_id %in% common)

# Bray–Curtis on relative abundances
X        <- t(counts)  # samples x ORFs
row_sums <- rowSums(X)
X_rel    <- sweep(X, 1, pmax(row_sums, 1e-12), "/")
D_bray   <- vegdist(X_rel, method = "bray")

# Reorder metadata to match distance matrix
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
meta    <- meta %>% slice(match(ord_ids, sample_id))

# Coerce factors (important)
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    Dx.Status = forcats::fct_relevel(as.factor(Dx.Status), "CONTROL"),
    onset_timeline_combined = as.factor(onset_timeline_combined),
    patientID = as.factor(patientID),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    HLA.Category = as.factor(HLA.Category),
    feeding_first_year = as.factor(feeding_first_year),
    Delivery.Mode = as.factor(Delivery.Mode),
    Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.)
  )

# ---- mixed MDMR: fixed effects + random intercept for patientID ----
fmla_mixed <- ~ Dx.Status * onset_timeline_combined + Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
               HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode + (1 | patientID)

# Tip for Bray (non-Euclidean): use.ssd ~ 0.99 can speed up
fit_mmdmr <- mixed.mdmr(
  fmla = fmla_mixed,
  data = meta,
  D    = D_bray,
  use.ssd = 0.99,   # set to 1.00 if you prefer full SSD (slower)
  ncores = 1        # >1 uses forking; keep 1 on Windows
)

# Results
res_tab <- summary(fit_mmdmr)           # Statistic, Numer DF, p-value per term
res_tab <- data.frame(res_tab) %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(`p.value`, method = "BH"))



ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
stopifnot(identical(meta$sample_id, ord_ids))

# Helper that runs MDMR for ONE timepoint, adjusting for covariates
run_mdmr_tp <- function(tp, meta, D_full, ord_ids, use_perm_p = FALSE, nperm = 4999, seed = 1L) {
  print(tp)
  df <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp) %>% droplevels()
  if (nrow(df) < 3 || n_distinct(df$Dx.Status) < 2) {
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status", Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  idx <- match(df$sample_id, ord_ids)
  if (any(is.na(idx))) {
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status", Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }
  D_tp <- as.dist(as.matrix(D_full)[idx, idx, drop = FALSE])


  # Quick degeneracy check (all pairwise distances == 0)
  M <- as.matrix(D_tp); U <- upper.tri(M, diag = FALSE)
  if (!any(U) || all(M[U] == 0)) {
    print("test")
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status",
                  Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  # Build X as a DATA FRAME with factors kept as factors
  X_df <- df %>%
    transmute(
      Dx.Status = factor(Dx.Status),
      Sex = factor(Sex),
      Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. = as.numeric(Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months.),
      HLA.Category = factor(HLA.Category),
      feeding_first_year = factor(feeding_first_year),
      Delivery.Mode = factor(Delivery.Mode)
    )

  # mdmr() expects X= (matrix or data.frame) and D=/G=
  # Use analytic p-values by default; or set use_perm_p = TRUE for permutation p's
  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    MDMR::mdmr(
      X = X_df,
      D = D_tp,
      perm.p = use_perm_p,
      nperm = if (use_perm_p) nperm else 500  # ignored if perm.p=FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    print("fit is still null")
    return(tibble(timepoint = tp, term = "Dx.Status",
                  Statistic = NA_real_, Numer.DF = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_))
  }

  
  sm <- data.frame(summary(fit)) %>%
        rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    filter(term == "Dx.Status1") %>%
    mutate(timepoint = tp) %>%
    select(timepoint,Statistic,Numer.DF,Pseudo.R2,Analytic.p.value)


}


# Run across timepoints (no random effect needed within TP)
tp_levels <- levels(meta$onset_timeline_combined)

per_tp_dx <- purrr::map_dfr(
  tp_levels,
  ~ run_mdmr_tp(.x, meta = meta, D_full = D_bray, ord_ids = ord_ids, use_perm_p = FALSE)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = ifelse(all(is.na(Analytic.p.value)), NA_real_, p.adjust(Analytic.p.value, method = "BH")))

# make plot
ord_ids <- rownames(as.matrix(D_bray))
stopifnot(identical(meta$sample_id, ord_ids))
meta <- droplevels(meta)

cap_one_tp <- function(tp, meta, D_full, ord_ids, fallback_pcoa = TRUE) {
  df <- meta %>% filter(onset_timeline_combined == tp) %>% droplevels()

  # need ≥ 3 samples total and ≥2 Dx groups
  if (nrow(df) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(df$Dx.Status) < 2) return(NULL)

  idx <- match(df$sample_id, ord_ids)
  if (any(is.na(idx))) return(NULL)

  subM <- as.matrix(D_full)[idx, idx, drop = FALSE]
  U <- upper.tri(subM, diag = FALSE)
  if (!any(U) || all(subM[U] == 0)) return(NULL)   # all distances 0 → degenerate

  D_tp <- as.dist(subM)

  # CAP: Dx constrained, covariates conditioned out
  cap <- tryCatch(
    vegan::capscale(
      D_tp ~ Dx.Status +
        Condition(Sex + Age.at.Gluten.Introduction..months. +
                  HLA.Category + feeding_first_year + Delivery.Mode),
      data = df, add = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(cap)) return(NULL)

  # Permutation test for Dx (marginal)
  aov_dx <- tryCatch(anova(cap, by = "margin", permutations = 9999),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
  p_dx <- if (!is.null(aov_dx) && "Dx.Status" %in% rownames(aov_dx)) {
    aov_dx["Dx.Status", "Pr(>F)"]
  } else NA_real_

  # If constrained rank is 0, optionally fall back to PCoA coords for plotting
  rank_con <- tryCatch(cap$CCA$rank, error = function(e) 0)
  if (is.na(rank_con)) rank_con <- 0

  if (rank_con < 1) {
    if (!fallback_pcoa) return(NULL)
    # PCoA (unconstrained) just to place points; keep p_dx for the label
    pcs <- tryCatch(cmdscale(D_tp, k = 2, eig = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(pcs)) return(NULL)
    CAP1 <- pcs$points[, 1]
    CAP2 <- if (ncol(pcs$points) >= 2) pcs$points[, 2] else rep(0, length(CAP1))
    v1 <- v2 <- NA_real_
  } else {
    # Safe score extraction
    scr <- tryCatch(scores(cap, display = "sites", choices = 1:2),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(scr)) return(NULL)
    scr <- as.matrix(scr)
    if (ncol(scr) < 1) return(NULL)
    CAP1 <- scr[, 1]
    CAP2 <- if (ncol(scr) >= 2) scr[, 2] else rep(0, length(CAP1))
    # % variance on constrained axes
    eig <- tryCatch(cap$CCA$eig, error = function(e) numeric(0))
    varex <- if (length(eig)) 100 * eig / sum(eig) else numeric(0)
    v1 <- if (length(varex) >= 1) varex[1] else NA_real_
    v2 <- if (length(varex) >= 2) varex[2] else NA_real_
  }

  tibble(
    sample_id = df$sample_id,
    timepoint = as.character(tp),
    Dx.Status = df$Dx.Status,
    CAP1 = CAP1,
    CAP2 = CAP2,
    p_dx = p_dx,
    pct_CAP1 = v1,
    pct_CAP2 = v2
  )
}

tp_levels <- levels(meta$onset_timeline_combined)
if (is.null(tp_levels)) tp_levels <- unique(meta$onset_timeline_combined)
```
